Color Discipline：克制的色板：阳光漂白的米色、干燥赭色、锈铁色、低饱和橄榄色。强调色：他的赤陶色皮肤／纹样、灼热的深红色敌方爆能枪弹束，以及耀眼的霓虹绿色等离子剑。高对比度；等离子剑刃在扬起的尘土上投下鲜明的绿色轮廓光。氛围：飞扬的沙尘、热浪扭曲、四溅火花、动感运动模糊。

The Character：锁定设计（匹配参考图）：KAEL DRAYN，Outer Rim Sentinel。带纹样的外星头尾、深色面部纹样、沉着专注的眼神。大地色战术装备、垂坠的橄榄色披肩兜帽、工具腰带、战斗靴。使用一柄可释放霓虹绿色等离子剑刃的机械剑柄。气质：训练有素、精准、不可动摇——身处混乱仍没有任何多余动作。

镜头 Design：轮换使用战斗镜头语法。Macros（拇指启动剑柄、绿色剑刃熔化一束深红爆能枪弹束、战术靴在沙地中转向）到 大幅度杂技式跳跃攻击。Hard diagonals、前景带遮挡的过肩视角、动态低角度 首屏 构图。光线：灼热严酷的日光，攻击时出现强烈的霓虹绿色环境辉光。3 个环境战斗画面：土坯墙上灼烧的爆炸痕迹、被切开的金属碎片坠落、风吹尘土覆盖脚印。

Story 弧线移动：以紧张的静止开场。预兆：移动的阴影、一名雇佣兵的武器发出咔嗒声。以防御姿态亮相：机械剑柄迅速抬起，剑刃点燃，紧凑微距构图 呈现快速格挡爆能枪射击。通过反击逐步升级：Kael 流畅地穿过交叉火力向前推进，以一连串模糊的跳跃劈击与旋转绿色光轨划破尘埃。以高潮画面收束：Kael 保持贴地低位姿态，剑已入鞘，披肩兜帽在风中飘动，在倒下的对手之间完全不为所动。各节拍之间使用 高速甩镜；保持动能与精准。

title: 照片与水彩插画对照海报
summary: 在同一版面展示原照片与水彩版本，练习用柔和色彩和线条表现人物关系。
use: 适合练习画面构图、风格控制和视觉素材制作。
preparation: 准备支持图片生成的 AI 工具，确定主题、画幅比例和需要出现的文字。提示词涉及参考图，请先准备自己的对应照片或产品图，并与提示词一起提交。
steps: 先看效果图，找出主体位置、配色和需要保留的细节。
复制下方中文提示词，把主体、品牌、地点或画面文字换成自己的内容；有【占位内容】时一并替换。
按提示词的要求提交参考图，先生成一张；对照要求检查主体、文字和构图，再针对问题修改。
lesson: 分别说明上下画面的表现方式，再明确两部分需要保持相同的主体、位置与构图。
exercise: 保留原有构图，换成自己的主题做一版；再只调整配色或材质，比较哪个变化最影响画面。
creator: @xiaoxiaodong01
promptOriginal:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，准确保持主体身份、情绪、姿态、空间关系、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，使其具有时尚杂志、艺术出版物与展览摄影质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展天空、地面或环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分提取照片中最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，重构为轻盈、稚拙、复古的手绘编辑插画。不要机械复刻细节，以概括造型、适度夸张比例、符号化特征和幽默视觉隐喻重新表达，同时保持原物一眼可辨。融合现代主义编辑插画、包豪斯平面构成、儿童绘本、稚拙艺术与时尚速写气质，形体简练，轮廓略带迟疑与手工误差，局部特征可适度放大，让画面兼具故事感、时尚感与俏皮感。

配色从上方照片中提取，采用高明度、低至中等饱和度的柔和有限色盘，以近似色统一氛围，小面积互补色制造视觉跳点。使用水彩、水粉、彩铅、粉蜡笔与干刷混合质感，保留纸张颗粒、透底、笔触断裂、边缘毛糙、轻微脏色与旧印刷套色偏差。背景大面积留白，仅以松散淡彩、局部斜线或简单几何元素承托主体，避免复杂场景堆积、写实光影、光滑矢量、3D渲染和过度精修。

文字从照片的地点、人物、场景或主题中提炼少量英文关键词、标题、编号或适配金句，并延续下半部分的手绘编辑语言。主标题采用略带稚拙与复古感的手写艺术字，辅助文字使用克制温和的无衬线或衬线字体，可轻微错位、倾斜、拉伸、叠色或产生旧印刷套色偏移，让文字像插画的一部分自然生长在画面中，而不是后期贴上的排版元素。

整体使用米白或浅色背景与大量留白，上下画面通过相同的主体特征、色彩、姿态和视觉符号形成呼应。整体气质轻松、俏皮、复古、温柔、聪明、时髦、幽默、浪漫、松弛，略带笨拙与古怪自信，像一页被精心保存的旧时尚绘本与现代艺术杂志。

promptOriginal:
Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal home-video showing an ordinary day in the life of a young Korean man. No reference image.

MAIN SUBJECT

Young Korean man in his early 20s, naturally attractive, realistic skin texture, minimal grooming, relaxed and slightly sleepy expression.

Medium-length naturally messy black hair, subtle stubble, a few loose strands falling across his forehead.

Wearing an oversized faded charcoal T-shirt, loose olive trousers, worn sneakers, and a simple silver watch.

Maintain the same face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and appearance throughout the entire video.

SETTING

A quiet older residential neighborhood during a warm summer afternoon.

Small apartment buildings, narrow concrete alleys, rooftop terraces, neighborhood laundries, corner shops, parked bicycles, potted plants, utility wires, concrete staircases, trees providing patches of shade, and ordinary people going about their day.

Everything should feel lived-in and authentic.

CAMERA / VISUAL AESTHETIC

Raw personal footage casually recorded by a friend.

Handheld camera with natural shake, imperfect framing, occasional partial crops, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts between sunlight and shade, mild motion blur, soft image detail, subtle digital noise, slightly faded colors, and natural camera imperfections.

The camera operator walks with him and reacts naturally.

No stabilization, no cinematic camera movements, no dramatic lighting, no slow motion, no polished commercial appearance.

The footage should feel accidentally beautiful rather than deliberately cinematic.

⸻

00:00–00:05 — LEAVING HOME

He steps out of his apartment carrying a small reusable shopping bag.

He locks the door, checks his pockets for his keys and phone, then starts walking downstairs.

The camera follows behind him.

He briefly looks back at the camera and gives a sleepy half-smile.

⸻

00:05–00:10 — MORNING ERRAND

He walks through a quiet neighborhood alley toward a small local grocery shop.

He passes parked bicycles and people watering plants outside their homes.

He stops at a roadside fruit stand and picks up a couple of oranges, inspecting them casually before placing them into his bag.

The camera briefly focuses on the fruit before returning to his face.

⸻

00:10–00:15 — SMALL BREAK

He sits on a low concrete wall outside the shop.

He opens a cold bottled drink and takes a few sips.

A breeze moves his hair.

He watches people passing by without saying anything.

The camera stays slightly shaky and imperfectly framed, as if his friend is simply sitting nearby filming him.

⸻

00:15–00:20 — WALKING HOME

He gets up and continues walking.

A bicycle passes behind him.

He notices a stray cat sitting beside a wall, crouches down and gently pets it.

The cat walks away.

He laughs quietly and stands back up.

The camera operator accidentally cuts off part of his head while moving closer, then quickly reframes him.

⸻

00:20–00:25 — ROOFTOP

He returns home and walks onto a small rooftop.

He places the shopping bag beside an old chair.

He leans against the railing and looks across the neighborhood.

The afternoon sunlight falls naturally across his face.

He runs his hand through his messy hair and quietly watches the distant buildings.

⸻

00:25–00:30 — FINAL MOMENT

He notices the camera still recording.

He looks directly into the lens and gives a tiny amused smile.

He casually says:

“You’re still recording?”

He shakes his head and walks toward the camera.

The camera moves backward slightly as he approaches.

The recording abruptly cuts to black before he reaches the camera.

⸻

AUDIO

Natural location sound only:

Footsteps, distant traffic, bicycles, birds, wind, neighborhood conversations, shop sounds, bottle opening, fabric movement, doors closing, and subtle handheld camera noise.

No music.

No narration.

No artificial sound effects.

Only the single spoken line: “You’re still recording?”

⸻

FINAL FEEL

The entire video should feel like a completely ordinary day that somehow became a beautiful memory.

Quiet, masculine, youthful, intimate, warm, slightly nostalgic, and spontaneous.

No dramatic events.

No exaggerated acting.

No model poses.

No cinematic hero shots.

The realism should come from tiny imperfections, casual body language, natural expressions, ordinary surroundings, imperfect camera operation, and moments that feel completely unplanned.
promptZh:
创作一段 30 秒、1080p、超写实的私人家庭录像，展现一名年轻韩国男子平凡的一天。无参考图像。

主要人物

一名 20 岁出头的年轻韩国男子，天生俊朗，皮肤纹理真实，几乎未经修饰，神情放松且略带困意。

中等长度、自然凌乱的黑发，淡淡的胡茬，几缕散发垂在额前。

穿着宽大的褪色炭灰色 T 恤、宽松的橄榄色长裤、旧运动鞋，并戴着一块简约银色手表。

整段视频中保持相同的面容、发型、服装、身体比例和外观。

场景

温暖夏日下午，一处安静的老旧住宅区。

小型公寓楼、狭窄的混凝土巷道、屋顶露台、社区洗衣店、街角商店、停放的自行车、盆栽、架空线缆、混凝土楼梯、洒下片片阴影的树木，以及各自过着日常生活的普通人。

一切都应有真实的生活气息。

镜头 / 视觉美学

由朋友随手录下的原生态私人影像。

手持 镜头，带有自然晃动、不完美的取景、偶尔出现的局部裁切、自动对焦来回寻找焦点、阳光与阴影之间的曝光变化、轻微 运动模糊、柔和的图像细节、细微数字噪点、略微褪色的色彩，以及自然的相机瑕疵。

镜头 operator 与他同行并自然做出反应。

无 防抖，无 电影感 镜头 动作，无戏剧性灯光，无 慢动作，无精致的商业广告质感。

影像应呈现一种无意间拍得很美的感觉，而非刻意营造的电影感。

⸻

00:00–00:05 — 离开家

他拎着一个小号环保购物袋走出公寓。

他锁好门，摸摸口袋确认钥匙和手机都在，然后开始下楼。

镜头 从他身后跟随。

他穿过安静的社区小巷，走向一家当地小杂货店。

他在路边水果摊停下，拿起两个橙子，随意查看后放进袋子里。

镜头 短暂聚焦水果，随后重新对准他的脸。

一辆自行车从他身后经过。

猫走开了。

他发现 镜头 仍在录制。

他直视镜头，露出一丝觉得好笑的微笑。

title: 东方奇幻角色立体肖像
summary: 用薄荷绿长发、服饰材质和梦幻花园构成角色肖像，练习造型与光线的协调。
use: 适合练习画面构图、风格控制和视觉素材制作。
preparation: 准备支持图片生成的 AI 工具，确定主题、画幅比例和需要出现的文字。
steps: 先看效果图，找出主体位置、配色和需要保留的细节。
复制下方中文提示词，把主体、品牌、地点或画面文字换成自己的内容；有【占位内容】时一并替换。
按提示词的要求提交参考图，先生成一张；对照要求检查主体、文字和构图，再针对问题修改。
lesson: 分别说明上下画面的表现方式，再明确两部分需要保持相同的主体、位置与构图。
exercise: 保留原有构图，换成自己的主题做一版；再只调整配色或材质，比较哪个变化最影响画面。

promptOriginal:
9:16 竖版，高精度 3D CG 东方幻想甜酷少女角色海报，3D CG oriental fantasy girl character portrait，anime-style 3D CG character art，semi-realistic 3D character render，full body portrait，画面主体是一位明确成年的年轻东方幻想系女性角色，视觉年龄约 20–24 岁，整体气质甜美、轻俏、元气、梦幻、带一点小恶魔精灵般的可爱感。整体不是平面插画，而是高完成度 3D CG 角色渲染，具有精致角色建模、真实材质表现、通透色彩、柔和光影与高级虚拟角色海报质感。

人物拥有精致甜美的东方美型脸，小巧鹅蛋脸，皮肤白皙细腻，带轻微通透感与柔和皮肤着色。眼睛大而明亮，瞳色为粉紫色与浅玫瑰紫混合，瞳孔有细腻玻璃高光，眼神温柔灵动，带一点俏皮与亲近感。睫毛纤长，眼妆清透自然，鼻梁秀气小巧，嘴唇柔软，唇色为低饱和樱花粉，神情轻松可爱，嘴角带浅浅微笑。

发型为薄荷蓝绿色长发，发丝丰盈顺滑，带高精度发丝建模与柔亮光泽，长发自然披散至腰间，发尾带轻微卷度与空气感。额前是轻盈碎刘海，两侧有柔软脸侧发修饰轮廓。人物拥有精致的浅色小角、尖耳与细长尾巴，增强东方幻想精灵 / 小恶魔气质。头部佩戴紫色蝴蝶结头饰与小型幻想装饰，细节精致统一。

服装保留原图的甜酷现代感，并调整为更精致的 3D CG 东方幻想日常造型：上身为浅粉色短款连帽卫衣，带淡紫色袖口、紫色蝴蝶结系带与胸前半透明爱心装饰，面料柔软蓬松，具有真实织物纹理；

下身为浅蓝色超低腰牛仔短裤，版型改为更贴身、更紧致的包裹式设计，牛仔面料紧紧贴合腰部、臀部与大腿根部，裤腰、裤脚边缘以及臀胯连接处要有比较明显的勒肉感与挤压感。短裤边缘轻微嵌入皮肤，形成自然柔软的肉感起伏，尤其是腰侧、胯部和大腿根位置要有清晰的紧绷受力效果，体现真实的紧身牛仔材质表现，而不是松垮平整的轮廓。既要突出纤细腰线，也要体现贴身短裤对臀胯与腿根的真实包裹感。

promptOriginal:
Photorealistic cinematic daytime amusement park roller coaster, bright hard sunlight, strong wind, realistic motion blur on tracks and background, subtle handheld camera energy, rich skin detail, heavy natural film grain.

0-5s: [Medium Shot] A young woman in her early 20s sits in the front seat of a moving roller coaster car, calm and slightly bored, hair whipping in the wind. Beside her sits a middle-aged man wearing what looks like a normal full head of hair. Behind them, another car with a woman is visible. The coaster drops and banks hard.

5-9s: [Dynamic Tracking] The force of the turn rips the man's wig free. It peels off his bald head in a chaotic upward arc, spinning and flying backward through the air. The wig lands messily on the head of the woman in the car behind. Everyone's faces freeze in pure shock and confusion at the peak of the chaos. Time locks completely. Only the young woman in the front keeps moving.

9-15s: [Slow Orbital + Detail] Camera slowly orbits the frozen cars. The wig hangs mid-air in a twisted shape with individual hairs suspended. The bald man's scalp is fully exposed, mouth open. The woman behind is frozen mid-scream with the wig draped over her face. The young woman looks sideways, rolls her eyes and mouths "joder, otra vez". She reaches into her pocket, pulls out a stick of chewing gum, unwraps it and calmly puts it in her mouth, starting to chew while the entire frozen scene (except her) begins a precise reverse.

15-20s: [Medium Close-up] The rewind is controlled and elegant: the wig lifts off the woman behind, flies backward through the air in reverse, and returns exactly to the moment it is only beginning to peel off the bald man's head. Time freezes again at that precise instant — the front edge of the wig just lifting, a few strands already loose.

20-26s: [Tight Medium] Still frozen for everyone else, the young woman takes the chewed gum out of her mouth, reaches over and firmly presses it onto the center of the bald man's scalp, right under the lifting wig. With the same hand she smooths and presses the wig back down into perfect place, locking it with the gum. She sits back, looks straight ahead with a tiny private smile, completely unbothered.

26-30s: [Medium Shot] Time suddenly resumes at full real-time speed. The coaster continues its drop. The man touches his head, feels the wig still firmly in place, looks confused for a second, then breaks into a relieved, happy smile. The young woman stares forward, already chewing a new piece of gum, expression of quiet satisfaction.

Photorealistic, ultra-detailed wind and hair physics, perfect motion blur only on moving elements, stable characters, cinematic lighting, heavy natural film grain, no artifacts, movie-level temporal coherence, high rewatch value.

0-5 秒：[中景] 一位二十出头的年轻女性坐在行驶中的过山车前排座位，神情平静、略带无聊，头发在风中飞扬。她旁边坐着一位中年男性，看起来有一头正常的浓密头发。他们身后能看到另一节车厢里坐着一位女性。过山车俯冲并急速转弯。

5-9 秒：[动态跟拍] 转弯的力道把男子的假发扯飞。假发以混乱的上扬弧线从他的秃头上剥离，旋转着向后飞去。假发凌乱地落在后排女性的头上。所有人的表情都在混乱的顶点定格成纯粹的震惊与困惑。时间彻底锁死。只有前排的年轻女性还在动。

9-15 秒：[缓慢环绕加细节] 镜头缓缓环绕冻结的车厢。假发以扭曲的形状悬停在半空，发丝一根根清晰可见。秃头男子的头皮完全暴露，嘴巴张开。后排女性定格在尖叫到一半的瞬间，假发盖在她脸上。年轻女性侧目，翻了个白眼，无声地说着又来了。她把手伸进口袋，掏出一片口香糖，拆开包装，平静地放进嘴里，开始咀嚼，与此同时整个冻结的场景（除了她）开始精确倒放。

15-20 秒：[中近景] 倒放过程受控而优雅：假发从后排女性头上飞起，反向穿过空中，精准地回到它刚开始从秃头男子头上剥离的那一刻。时间在这个精确瞬间再次冻结，假发的前缘刚刚翘起，几缕发丝已经松开。

20-26 秒：[紧凑中景] 其他人依旧冻结，年轻女性把嚼过的口香糖从嘴里取出，伸手把它牢牢按在秃头男子头顶正中央，正好在翘起的假发下方。她用同一只手把假发抚平按回原位，用口香糖把它固定住。她坐回座位，直视前方，带着一丝不为人知的微笑，完全不受影响。

26-30 秒：[中景] 时间突然恢复到实时全速。过山车继续俯冲。男子摸了摸头，感觉假发依然牢牢固定，困惑了一秒，随即露出如释重负的开心笑容。年轻女性直视前方，已经在嚼一片新的口香糖，神情安静满足。

照相写实，超精细的风与头发物理效果，运动模糊只出现在运动元素上，角色稳定，电影感布光，浓重的自然胶片颗粒，无伪影，电影级时序连贯，高重复观看价值。

promptOriginal: 人设修仙武者：年轻男性，身姿挺拔，气质清冷出尘、仙风道骨；御剑飞行双脚踏着巨剑剑身上，处于战斗施法状态，先后单手结印、双手结印。足下巨剑：宽大厚重，剑身泛寒光，可一分为五，在修仙武者脚下呈扇形展开。巨型妖兽：穷奇外形的庞然巨兽，体型如小山般巨大，四足粗壮、巨爪如柱；处于发狂肆虐状态，四爪先后被锁、挣扎咆哮。场景玄幻仙侠架空世界，一片人迹罕至的荒山野地作为主要空间环境参考，开阔荒原，远处连绵荒山轮廓，偶有碎石与低矮枯木。战斗后期巨兽头顶上空汇聚雷云。画面风格3D CG 高精度建模动画，国漫精品剧集质感；玄幻仙侠题材，写实 CG 建模与毛发皮肤细节，仙术法阵与雷霆特效能量感强烈；宏大战斗场面调度，史诗感。影调开阔荒原大场景、宏大空间纵深；主发光源来自法术能量：巨剑分身寒光、金色法阵明亮金辉自地面向上映照巨兽身型、白紫色雷霆爆裂闪光；雷云汇聚后环境被云层阴影笼罩、明暗对比加剧，法阵金光与雷光交替勾勒妖兽与武者的轮廓；妖兽挣扎时尘土飞扬、暗部细节增多。视觉参考参考国漫《灵笼》《凡人修仙传》CG 剧集视觉质感：高精度角色建模、材质与光影写实、仙术特效的能量流动与光效层次、大场景运镜调度。全局约束无字幕、禁止生成字幕。分镜1，0s-2s，大远景，固定镜头，高机位轻微俯拍，从年轻修仙武者身后拍摄，武者脚踏巨剑剑身御剑悬停在空中位于画面的左上角，镜头视线聚焦下方的荒原野地：一头穷奇外形的巨型妖兽正在荒地上发狂肆虐，挥动巨爪拍碎地面、仰头咆哮，扬起大片尘土碎石；音效：妖兽低沉咆哮、爪击地面的闷响、碎石飞溅声。分镜2，2s-4s，中近景，固定镜头，聚焦悬停空中的武者上半身近景，武者目光一凝，随即抬手单手结印，口唇快速念出咒语「分则能成！」；音效：低沉咒语吟诵声。分镜3，4s-5s，切换武者脚下巨剑特写，固定镜头，脚下的巨剑剑身泛起光纹、嗡鸣震动，随即一分为五，在修仙武者脚下呈扇形展开，巨剑本体仍位于武者脚下；音效：剑身震颤金属嗡鸣。分镜4，5s-8s，大远景→妖兽四只巨爪的局部中景，荷兰角，快速跟拍，镜头紧密跟随四把分身巨剑的飞射轨迹跟拍。四把分身巨剑如流光般疾速飞射而下，分别命中妖兽四只巨爪，击中瞬间化作虚灵形态的灵光锁链缠绕锁紧四爪；妖兽四爪被锁、挣扎甩动却无法挣脱，仰头怒吼；音效：剑气破空声、锁链缠绕铮鸣、妖兽挣扎怒吼、地面震颤闷响。分镜5，8s-10s，特写，固定镜头，聚焦武者胸前结印的双手。高空中的武者双手抬起、十指交叠快速多次结印，法力凝聚的微光在掌间亮起，随即放声暴喝；对白：修仙武者（怒喝）：「雷光咒！」；音效：灵力汇聚的低沉嗡鸣、武者暴喝声、妖兽持续咆哮。分镜6，10s-11s，全景，仰拍后拉。妖兽脚下的地面骤然亮起一个与它身型投影同样巨大的金色法阵，符文旋转展开、金光上涌，将挣扎的妖兽笼罩其中；音效：法阵启动的深沉轰鸣、能量流动的嗡嗡声。分镜7，11s-15s，大远景，仰拍。妖兽头顶上空乌云迅速汇聚，雷云翻滚、电光在云层中窜动，天色骤然压暗；一道巨大白紫色雷霆从乌云中迸发，自天而降击中巨兽身体，法阵金光与雷光同时爆发，妖兽身形被耀眼光芒吞没、剧烈震颤；音效：雷云翻滚闷响、电流滋啦声、雷霆炸裂巨响、轰鸣回响、大地震动。全局配乐：纯音乐 + 无词吟唱0s-2s：琵琶轮指 + 二胡紧张颤音长音，低音提琴拨弦脉冲；旋律短促、小二度游移（不安定感），音量中等、密度低2s-4s：琵琶扫弦 + 古筝十六分音符急奏，堂鼓+小钹进入密集节奏层，弦乐群齐奏推高4s-5s：大鼓滚奏渐密，铜管短促强音（"锁"的动作感），低频持续音垫底；妖兽咆哮处配乐主动让位——音量降、减旋律密度，给咆哮音效留空间5s-8s：只留低频持续音 + 箫孤音。打击乐静默、旋律消失8s-10s：古筝泛音 + 弦乐长音渐强，无词女声"啊——"进入（非歌词）；和声从暗小调切向明亮大三和弦的临时离调10s-11s：大鼓滚奏 + 定音鼓渐强，弦乐密集颤音，30-60Hz 低频持续轰鸣；旋律线消失，只剩节奏与和声爬升；11s-15s：大鼓+定音鼓+镲片同击，唢呐/铜管齐奏强音，琵琶古筝最高密度扫弦；雷光爆闪处配乐让位 0.3s 给雷声音效；结尾快速衰减至低频余震 + 箫尾音

title: 暖金侧光的男子肖像
summary: 用侧面构图、深色服装和暖金光线塑造人物轮廓，同时保留参考面孔。
use: 适合练习画面构图、风格控制和视觉素材制作。
preparation: 准备支持图片生成的 AI 工具，确定主题、画幅比例和需要出现的文字。提示词涉及参考图，请先准备自己的对应照片或产品图，并与提示词一起提交。
steps: 先看效果图，找出主体位置、配色和需要保留的细节。
复制下方中文提示词，把主体、品牌、地点或画面文字换成自己的内容；有【占位内容】时一并替换。
按提示词的要求提交参考图，先生成一张；对照要求检查主体、文字和构图，再针对问题修改。
lesson: 把主体、画面布局、风格与限制分开描述，比只写一个风格名称更容易说明目标。
exercise: 保留原有构图，换成自己的主题做一版；再只调整配色或材质，比较哪个变化最影响画面。

title: 纸艺风格的历史人物短片
summary: 把历史人物题材压缩成十五秒纸艺场景，练习分层布景与镜头衔接。
use: 适合练习短片分镜、动作连续性和声音描述。
preparation: 准备支持视频生成的工具，先确认可选时长、画幅和声音设置。
steps: 先看视频，再阅读完整提示词，标出每段镜头的时长、主体动作和衔接位置。
替换人物、产品或场景时，同步检查全文的称呼、服装和外观描述，保持前后一致。
按工具支持的时长制作；超过单次时长的内容按镜头拆段，并保留承接动作，最后拼接。
检查人物是否变化、动作是否连贯、声音是否对齐；一次只调整最明显的问题。
lesson: 把时长、主体、镜头和声音分字段写出，便于逐项替换，也便于定位需要修改的部分。
exercise: 先保留镜头顺序，只替换一个主体或场景。若动作开始不连贯，减少同一段内的动作数量。

promptOriginal:
Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal home-video showing an ordinary summer morning in the life of a young Korean woman. No reference image.
MAIN SUBJECT
Young Korean woman in her early 20s, naturally pretty, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup and relaxed personality.
Long black wavy hair loosely tied into a messy side ponytail with a few loose strands around her face. Wearing a fitted white short top, loose light-blue pajama-style pants, black sneakers and a simple silver necklace.
Maintain the same face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions and overall appearance throughout the entire video.
SETTING
A quiet older Seoul residential neighborhood during a warm summer morning. Small houses, concrete stairs, narrow alleys, potted plants, bicycles, old walls, overhead wires, neighborhood taps and large leafy trees.
Everything feels lived-in, ordinary and peaceful.
CAMERA / VISUAL AESTHETIC
Raw personal footage recorded by a friend on an early-2000s consumer DV camcorder.
Strong handheld shake, slightly crooked framing, autofocus hunting, faded colors, soft digital detail, exposure shifts, occasional motion blur, mild digital noise and imperfect zooms.
No stabilization, drone footage or polished commercial cinematography.
— OUTSIDE HER HOME
She sits on the concrete steps outside her house looking slightly sleepy.
She notices the public water tap beside the entrance, gets up and walks toward it.
She turns the tap on and splashes cool water onto her face with both hands.
Water droplets remain visible on her skin as she looks toward the camera and smiles.
She says:
"Way too hot already."
— MORNING ROUTINE
She wipes her face with a small towel and ties her messy ponytail a little tighter.
She takes a sip from a cold bottled drink sitting beside the tap.
The camera zooms awkwardly toward her wet face, briefly loses focus, then snaps back.
She laughs at the camera.
— WALK THROUGH THE LANE
She grabs a small reusable shopping bag and starts walking down the narrow street.
She passes a neighbor sweeping outside their home and gives them a cheerful morning greeting.
A bicycle rolls past her and she steps aside, laughing as the camera nearly misses the moment.
— SMALL BREAKFAST STOP
She reaches a tiny neighborhood bakery and looks through the window.
She buys a warm pastry, steps outside and immediately takes a bite.
She smiles with genuine satisfaction and holds the pastry toward the camera.
— UNEXPECTED FRIEND
Her friend suddenly appears at the end of the alley and calls her.
She turns around, waves excitedly and walks toward them.
They briefly chat while standing beside a row of bicycles, then start walking together down the lane.
— FINAL MOMENT
They reach a large tree casting shade across the street.
She sits on a low concrete wall, finishes her pastry and looks peacefully down the quiet neighborhood.
Her friend points the camera toward her.
She notices and says:
"Okay, that's enough filming."
She reaches toward the lens with her hand.
The image becomes blurry as her fingers cover the camera.
The recording abruptly cuts to black.
AUDIO
Natural location sound only: running water, birds, summer insects, footsteps, bicycle bells, distant scooters, sweeping sounds, bakery ambience, quiet conversations and subtle camcorder handling noise.
No music. No narration. No artificial sound effects.
Only the two spoken lines specified above.
FINAL FEEL
The entire video should feel like a real forgotten summer morning recording from the early 2000s.
Casual, feminine, warm, nostalgic and slightly funny.
No dramatic events, no model poses, no polished commercial shots.
The realism should come from wet skin, real water droplets, imperfect handheld footage, ordinary Korean streets, natural expressions and tiny everyday interactions.

由朋友使用 early-2000s 家用数码摄像机 拍摄的原始个人影像。

她坐在屋外的混凝土台阶上，看起来有些困倦。
她注意到入口旁的公用水龙头，于是起身朝它走去。

她用一条小毛巾擦脸，把凌乱的马尾扎得稍紧一些。
她喝了一口放在水龙头旁的冰镇瓶装饮料。
镜头 笨拙地 变焦 toward 她湿润的脸，短暂失焦，然后迅速重新对焦。
她对着 镜头 大笑。

她拿起一个小号可重复使用购物袋，开始沿狭窄街道行走。
她经过一位正在屋外扫地的邻居，愉快地向对方道早安。
一辆自行车从她身边驶过，她侧身让开；镜头 差点错过这一刻，她笑了起来。

她买了一份热腾腾的酥点，走到外面立刻咬了一口。

她的朋友突然出现在巷子尽头并呼唤她。
她转过身，兴奋地挥手并朝对方走去。
她们站在一排自行车旁简短交谈，随后一起沿巷子往前走。
— 最后一刻
她们来到一棵在街道上投下阴影的大树旁。
她坐在一堵低矮的混凝土墙上，吃完酥点，平静地望着这片安静的社区。
她的朋友把 镜头 对准她。
她注意到后说道：
“好了，拍得够多了。”
她伸手探向 镜头。
随着她的手指盖住 镜头，画面变得模糊。
录像突然切至黑屏。
音频
仅使用自然的现场声音：流水声、鸟鸣、夏虫声、脚步声、自行车铃声、远处的踏板车声、扫地声、面包店环境声、轻声交谈和细微的 摄像机 操作声。
无音乐。无旁白。无人工音效。
只出现上面指定的两句台词。
最终感觉
整段视频应像是一份来自 early 2000s、被遗忘的真实夏日早晨录像。
随意、柔美、温暖、怀旧，并略带诙谐。
无戏剧性事件、无模特姿势、无精致的商业 镜头。
真实感应来自湿润的皮肤、真实的水珠、不完美的 手持 录像画面、平凡的韩国街道、自然的表情以及细微的日常互动。

promptOriginal:
GPT image 2.0 on ChatGPT.

Prompt.

Create one independent editorial-style poster for each uploaded photo. Do not make a collage. Process and output each photo separately.

Use a strict 3:4 vertical composition, divided horizontally into two exactly equal sections, each occupying 50% of the canvas.

TOP HALF — ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH
Preserve the original photo. Keep the main subject unchanged while retaining its realistic texture, natural lighting, and original color atmosphere. Apply only subtle editorial-grade color correction to create the refined feel of an art magazine, independent publication, or exhibition photography.

To fit the composition, you may gently extend the sky, ground, or surrounding environmental background, but do not stretch, distort, or alter the main subject.

BOTTOM HALF — LAYERED PAPER CUT / PAPER ART REINTERPRETATION
Reinterpret the most recognizable subject, silhouette, pose, and spatial relationships from the photo as a minimalist layered paper-cut / paper-art composition.

Use one primary subject as the visual anchor. Do not mechanically reproduce every detail. Instead, reconstruct the key silhouette, proportions, and structure through folding, cutting, layering, and overlapping.

Transform only a few supporting environmental elements into foreground, midground, and background paper layers. Use scale contrast, negative space, clean alignment, and front-to-back layering to make the subject immediately recognizable while maintaining a restrained editorial composition.

COLOR & MATERIAL
Extract the most distinctive and recognizable colors from the original photo, then reduce them into a limited and harmonious paper-art palette.

Use warm ivory or light-colored paper as the base, supported by a small amount of stronger accent colors, darker structural tones, soft transitional layer colors, and very limited highlights.

The material should resemble high-quality matte cardstock, with subtle visible paper fibers, clean cut edges, and soft contact shadows under natural diffused lighting. Emphasize the tactile quality of real handcrafted paper art.

Avoid glossy plastic-like 3D effects, cheap craft-paper aesthetics, neon colors, and overly saturated or complex gradients.

EDITORIAL TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM
Add a refined editorial typography system. Based on the identity, location, action, material, emotion, or symbolic meaning of the subject, create one short main title.

Add 2–4 groups of smaller supporting text. These may include object names, location information, numbers, sequence markers, coordinate-like numbers, direction words, status words, material descriptions, classification labels, or a very short poetic phrase.

Do not use any year or date.

The main title should convey emotion and identity, while the smaller text should add rhythm, structure, and refinement.

TYPOGRAPHY INTEGRATION
Integrate the typography naturally into the composition so that it interacts with the paper-cut forms. Arrange text along paper-layer edges, subject contours, geometric axes, or areas of negative space.

Use horizontal or vertical typesetting, rotated text, generous letter spacing, edge alignment, corner placement, cross-section layouts, embedded typography, or partially overlapped text.

The main title may have a subtle paper-cut or folded-paper quality, while the supporting text should remain thin, modern, restrained, and precise.

The final result should feel elegant, tactile, balanced, art-directed, and distinctly editorial.
promptZh:
ChatGPT 上的 GPT image 2.0。

提示词。

为每张上传的照片分别创作一张独立的编辑风格海报。不要制作拼贴画。分别处理并输出每张照片。

使用严格的 3:4 竖向 构图，横向划分为两个完全相等的部分，每部分各占画布的 50%。

TOP HALF — 原始照片
保留原始照片。保持主体不变，同时保留其逼真纹理、自然光线和原始色彩氛围。仅进行轻微的编辑级调色，以营造艺术杂志、独立出版物或展览摄影般的精致质感。

为了适配构图，可以适度延展天空、地面或周围环境背景，但不要拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

BOTTOM HALF — 分层剪纸 / 纸艺再诠释
将照片中最具辨识度的主体、轮廓、姿势和空间关系重新诠释为极简的分层剪纸 / 纸艺构图。

以一个主要主体作为视觉锚点。不要机械地复刻每处细节，而应通过折叠、裁切、分层和叠加来重构关键轮廓、比例与结构。

仅将少量辅助环境元素转化为 前景、中景 和 背景 纸张层次。使用比例对比、留白、整洁对齐和由前至后的分层，使主体一眼可辨，同时保持克制的编辑构图。

色彩与材质
从原始照片中提取最独特、最具辨识度的色彩，再将其精简为有限且和谐的纸艺色板。

以暖象牙色或浅色纸张为基底，辅以少量更强烈的强调色、较深的结构色调、柔和的过渡层颜色和极少的高光。

材质应类似高品质哑光卡纸，具有细微可见的纸纤维、整洁的裁切边缘，以及自然漫射光下柔和的接触阴影。强调真实手工纸艺的触感品质。

避免光亮塑料般的 3D 效果、廉价手工纸美学、霓虹色，以及过度饱和或复杂的渐变。

编辑字体系统
添加一套精致的编辑字体系统。根据主体的身份、地点、动作、材质、情绪或象征意义，创作一个简短主标题。

添加 2–4 组较小的辅助文字。其中可包括物体名称、地点信息、数字、序列标记、类似坐标的数字、方向词、状态词、材质描述、分类标签或一句极短的诗意短语。

不要使用任何年份或日期。

主标题应传达情绪与身份，较小文字则应增添节奏、结构和精致感。

字体整合
将字体自然融入构图，使其与剪纸形态产生互动。沿纸张层次边缘、主体轮廓、几何轴线或留白区域排列文字。

使用横向或纵向排版、旋转文字、宽松字间距、边缘对齐、角落布局、cross-区块 layouts、嵌入式字体或部分重叠文字。

主标题可呈现微妙的剪纸或折纸质感，而辅助文字应保持纤细、现代、克制且精确。

最终成果应呈现优雅、富有触感、平衡、经过艺术指导且鲜明的编辑风格。

promptOriginal:
30-SECOND CINEMATIC MORNING VLOG — “FROM BED TO OUTSIDE”

Use the user-provided character reference as a strict identity lock and the user-provided outfit reference exactly. Keep the same face, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing, shoes, and accessories throughout the entire video. Use the same dog consistently in every shot.

FORMAT: 16:9 widescreen, photorealistic, premium lifestyle vlog, cinematic natural lighting, realistic motion, subtle film grain, warm morning color grading.

0–5 SEC — WAKE UP
Soft morning sunlight enters the bedroom. The character slowly wakes up, sits on the edge of the bed, runs a hand through his hair, and takes a quiet moment before getting up. Slow cinematic push-in, natural bedroom ambience.
5–10 SEC — COFFEE
Cut to the kitchen. He prepares a simple morning coffee. Close-up of coffee beans, water pouring, coffee filling the cup, then him taking the first sip beside the kitchen window. Warm sunlight, shallow depth of field, gentle handheld camera movement.

10–15 SEC — GETTING READY
He puts on his shoes, grabs his keys and leash, and looks toward his dog waiting excitedly near the door. Quick but smooth cinematic cuts. The dog happily follows him toward the entrance.
15–25 SEC — MORNING WALK
He steps outside with his dog into a peaceful morning street. They walk casually together through a quiet neighborhood. Capture wide establishing shots, low-angle walking shots, close-ups of their feet, the dog walking beside him, and natural sunlight filtering through trees.

25–30 SEC — FINAL SHOT
Wide cinematic shot from behind as the character and dog continue walking down the street. He briefly looks toward the morning sky while the dog walks beside him. Slow camera pull-back, peaceful ending.

promptOriginal:
Please create a separate, independently designed premium poster from each uploaded photo. Do not combine multiple photos into one composition; output one individual poster for each photo. Use a vertical 3:4 composition, with the upper and lower sections strictly divided 1:1, each occupying exactly 50% of the total height.

Upper Half:  
Preserve the original photograph, maintaining the subject’s identity, structure, pose, realistic texture, natural lighting, and original color atmosphere. Apply only subtle, sophisticated color grading to give it the visual quality of an art magazine, independent publication, or exhibition image. To adapt the image to the 3:4 format, the surrounding background may be naturally extended, but do not stretch, distort, or alter the subject.

Lower Half:  
Extract the most recognizable subject, silhouette, structure, pose, and narrative relationship from the photograph and reconstruct it in the style of Mid-century vernacular graphic illustration + schematic line drawing + two-color spot printing.

Do not completely trace or replicate the photograph. Instead, use diagrammatic abstraction to compress complex objects into a small number of clear geometric shapes, functional contours, and essential structural elements. The result should resemble an illustration from an old instruction manual, advertising card, technical label, or vernacular print: immediately recognizable, yet more direct, humorous, and symbolic than the realistic object itself.

Emphasize economy of line: if a structure can be explained with a single line, do not use unnecessary strokes. Use direct black pen outlines, rectangles, circles, diamonds, straight lines, and simple planes to describe the objects. People, animals, and objects may have slightly exaggerated proportions, while machines, buildings, and complex structures should be simplified into clear boxes, openings, panels, and silhouette relationships.

Use a flat, schematic diagrammatic perspective rather than realistic lighting or strictly accurate spatial depth. The visual language should exist somewhere between illustration and technical diagram, maintaining this distinctive character throughout the composition.

Reorganize the composition according to the most important narrative relationship in the original image. Maintain one clear primary subject, while using a small number of supporting objects, guide lines, directional relationships, or structural symbols to reinforce the story.

Pay close attention to visual hierarchy, geometric order, scale contrast, positive and negative space, and intentional whitespace. The image may feel slightly naïve, awkward, or handmade in a vernacular way, but it must never feel cluttered. Every visual element should appear to exist for the purpose of “explaining what is happening”, rather than simply serving as decoration.
promptZh:
请为每张上传的照片分别创作一张独立设计的高端海报。不要将多张照片合并到同一个构图中；每张照片各输出一张独立海报。采用竖版 3:4 构图，上下两部分严格按 1:1 划分，各占总高度的 50%。

上半部分：  
保留原始照片，保持主体的身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光线和原有色彩氛围。仅进行细腻、精致的调色，使其呈现艺术杂志、独立出版物或展览图像的视觉品质。为适配 3:4 格式，可以自然延展周围背景，但不要拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分：  
从照片中提取最具辨识度的主体、轮廓、结构、姿态和叙事关系，以世纪中叶民间平面插画 + 示意线描 + 双色专色印刷的风格重新构建。

不要完整描摹或复制照片。应通过图解式抽象，将复杂物体浓缩为少量清晰的几何形状、功能性轮廓和必要的结构元素。成品应像旧式使用手册、广告卡片、技术标签或民间印刷品中的插画：一眼就能辨认，却比真实物体本身更直接、更幽默、更具象征性。

强调线条的简练：如果一条线就能说明某个结构，就不要添加多余笔画。用直接的黑色钢笔轮廓线、矩形、圆形、菱形、直线和简单平面来描绘物体。人物、动物和物品的比例可以略微夸张，而机器、建筑和复杂结构则应简化为清晰的盒状形体、开口、面板及轮廓之间的关系。

采用平面化、示意性的图解透视，而非写实光影或严格准确的空间纵深。视觉语言应介于插画与技术图解之间，并在整个构图中始终保持这一独特特征。

根据原图中最重要的叙事关系重新组织构图。保留一个明确的主要主体，同时用少量辅助物体、引导线、方向关系或结构符号强化故事。

仔细处理视觉层级、几何秩序、大小对比、正负空间和有意安排的留白。画面可以带有些许民间创作式的稚拙、生涩或手工感，但绝不能杂乱。每个视觉元素都应服务于“解释正在发生什么”，而非仅仅充当装饰。

promptOriginal:
Raw vertical phone video (UGC), handheld throughout, filmed by a friend who walks with the group, casual sway, natural night lighting, wide-angle lens, deep focus.

Characters: The hero is a young woman with long dark hair in a deep-purple one-shoulder dress with a small shoulder bag. Her three friends: one in a dark brown dress, a blonde in a black wrap dress, a blonde in a white mini dress — party dresses and sandals. Laughing, spontaneous night-out energy.

Setting: A luxury marina at night — a stone quay along a narrow water slip flanked on both sides by large moored luxury yachts, big white hulls rising on either side, masts and rigging above, fenders on the hulls. Warm orange street lamps, palm trees, distant city lights. The yachts glow with blue-turquoise underwater LED lights spilling into the water; a yellow mooring line runs to the stone.

[0.0s–4.0s] — Wide tracking shot, eye level, camera moving backward. The camera walks backward ahead of the four women as they stroll toward it down the marina promenade, framed head-to-toe, laughing and chatting in French; warm lamplight and palm trees behind, slight handheld bob.

[4.0s–6.0s] — Medium shot, eye level, backward track + quick left pan. The woman in the purple dress surges ahead of the group toward the lens, one arm raised, hair flying; the camera, on their left, keeps tracking back and pans to hold her.

[6.0s–8.0s] — Medium-wide, camera tilts down-left to follow, whip motion. She reaches the quay edge between the moored luxury yachts and launches headfirst over the edge; the handheld camera whips left and tilts down to chase her off the stone.

[8.0s–10.0s] — High-angle wide, looking down at the water, slight jolt. From up on the quay the camera looks down as she plunges headfirst into the blue-turquoise water in the slip between the big yacht hulls — a big splash, the underwater lights glowing around the impact; the handheld frame jolts slightly with the motion.

[10.0s–13.0s] — High-angle medium, looking down, small handheld drift. She surfaces in the teal water, gasping and laughing up at the camera, hair slicked back, treading water.

[13.0s–16.0s] — Handheld tilt up and back down, slight zoom. The camera lifts off the water and tilts up to a person leaning on the deck railing of one of the moored luxury yachts, watching her in the water, then tilts back down and zooms slightly in on her still treading and laughing.

[16.0s–20.0s] — High-angle medium, tilting to follow her up. She swims to the stone quay wall, reaches up and grabs a thick dark mooring pole, and hauls herself out; the camera tilts upward with her as she rises from the water, legs braced on the stone.

[20.0s–23.0s] — Low/close medium at the quay edge, static handheld. She climbs onto the stone lip, rolls onto her side, soaked dress clinging, then pushes up to her feet; the camera holds close, catching the water running off her.

[23.0s–27.0s] — Medium shot, eye level, loose handheld reframe. Back on the promenade, dripping wet, she flips her long wet hair forward and wrings it out, laughing, as her friends and passing pedestrians move behind her.

[27.0s–30.0s] — Medium shot, eye level, camera settles. Still dripping, she straightens up and strikes a confident, playful pose for the camera — hand on hip, tossing her wet hair back with a big smile — her friends laughing around her; the camera holds on the pose to end.

Audio: Live sync sound — friends laughing and shouting excitedly in French, a scream at the leap, a big water splash, water sloshing against the yacht hulls, wet footsteps on stone, ambient night marina sounds. No music.

Style: Raw amateur vertical phone footage, natural night lighting, warm street lamps mixing with the turquoise underwater yacht glow, authentic handheld motion.

[20.0s–23.0s] — Low/码头边的近中景, 静止 手持。她爬上石岸边沿，侧身翻滚，湿透的连衣裙紧贴身体，随后撑起身站立；镜头近距离保持拍摄，捕捉从她身上流下的水。

[27.0s–30.0s] — 中景, eye level, 镜头 settles。她仍在滴水，挺直身体，面向镜头摆出自信俏皮的姿势——一手叉腰，带着灿烂笑容将湿发甩回身后——朋友们围着她大笑；镜头保持这一姿势直至结束。

1. THE SCENE — 这场灾难是整个故事的核心，必须通过精确的 因果链 清晰呈现，由构图和 镜头 讲述这个残酷的故事。ANA 抱着婴儿单臂攀爬时，脚下踩落一块岩板；岩板朝下方年幼的 UMAI 坠落；一只 狼 跃出，在岩板砸中前一瞬间 用身体 猛撞 UMAI，将她推出危险区域——这只狼救了她。随后狼群涌入并带走 UMAI。狼群没有攻击她——第一只狼救了她，狼群将她带走。这个反转就是一切。
2. 因果链 — 在画面中逐一编排每个环节，先因后果，以 每两帧步进 呈现：(a) ANA 的脚踩到悬崖高处的一块岩架，岩架在她的重量下 CRACKS 并 BREAKS；(b) 一块沉重的 岩板 松脱，径直朝 UMAI FALLS——坠落的岩石是贯穿始终的线索；(c) UMAI 正站在下方，抬头仰望；(d) 一只 狼 从侧面 LAUNCHES，用肩膀和身体 SLAMS UMAI——不是用嘴，不是撕咬——将她撞向侧面，脱离危险；(e) 岩板 CRASHES 进她刚才站立位置的雪地，以 每两帧步进 呈现粉雪爆开；(f) UMAI 毫发无伤地翻滚到狼群之中。每个原因都必须可见。
3. 狼用身体救援 — CRITICAL：第一只狼用肩膀/侧腹撞击 UMAI，是一次 SHOVE，嘴巴 不是压在她身上，没有撕咬，没有叼起——必须让人看出这是一次 身体撞击 式营救。有一瞬间，它 看起来像袭击——接着岩石砸中空无一人的雪地，我们才明白狼救了她。演出这次震撼反转。
4. 狼群带走她 — 狼群如一股迅疾的黑色洪流从 @[Image 4](image_4) 涌入，毛色各异，将 UMAI 被带起，进入狼群之间，不是撕扯她，而是把她裹挟在洪流中，奔入 雾 与 blizzard。她在流动的黑色群体中显得无比渺小，被带入白茫茫之中。这是她在狼群中生活的开端。
5. 上方的 ANA 看见并尖叫 — ANA 身处悬崖高处，无能为力，一只手臂抱着婴儿，另一只手攀附岩壁；她 SEES 这一幕，伸出手并 SCREAMS 女儿的名字。FACIAL ACTING：她强撑的镇定 SHATTERS——面容彻底崩溃，双眼因恐惧睁到极致，嘴巴猛然张开，此前所有克制的温柔都炸裂为赤裸的惊恐；以 每两帧步进 呈现一张脸在定格姿势间猛然崩塌。
6. 镜头 LAW（角度 与 高度 讲述残酷）— 镜头 1 在高处 WITH ANA，随后以猛烈的 制造眩晕感的向下俯摇 跟随坠落的岩石——高度是残酷的机制，她无意间成为来自上方的起因。镜头 2 在 UMAI 的视线高度或更低处 LOW 拍摄——让我们与孩子共同感受无助，岩石与狼都朝我们压来。镜头 4 使用 强调大小对比的角度——ANA 在广阔悬崖高处显得渺小而无力，风暴令她更加微不足道，她绝不强大，只有无助。全程使用富有攻击性的 dynamic 手持，尖叫时 horizon 剧烈倾斜，不要稳定器般平滑，不要三脚架固定感。
7. 构图 LAW（画面讲述故事——RUPTURE，与誓言中的 affinity 截然相反）— LINE：营救时残酷交叉的力量——厄运的 竖向 line（从上方坠落的岩石）与救赎的 HORIZONTAL line（从侧面冲来的狼）相交；二者在渺小孩子身上的交点，就是故事本身。狼群的流动形成一条 斜向动势线，将她席卷带走。上方母亲与下方孩子之间的垂直距离从此 PERMANENT 且辽阔。SHAPE：棱角分明的岩石与棱角分明的扑跃之狼（两者看起来都是威胁）一同逼近圆润娇小的孩子。TONE：浅色雪地与 雾 上的深色块面（岩石、狼、狼群），孩子是焦点。运动：强烈对比与高强度——快速猛烈的垂直坠落、水平撞击、对角席卷，对照缓慢而无助的伸手动作。CONTRAST & AFFINITY：最大程度的 CONTRAST 和 PEAK 视觉强度——这正是誓言中的 affinity 一直为之蓄势的决裂。SPACE：深邃的垂直空间，残酷的距离。
8. 框景式水墨调度（以块面理解）— 画面-TRAP：将渺小的孩子困在上方坠落的岩石与侧面扑来的狼之间，两块深色、棱角分明的物体同时逼近她。CONCEAL：雾 半吞没这场灾难，并在狼群把 UMAI 带入白茫茫之中时将她吞没。镜头 高度：在孩子处低矮而无助；在母亲处渺小而无力。大与小的对比：渺小的孩子与远处渺小的母亲，对抗广阔悬崖、风暴和黑暗流动的狼群。
9. WEATHER — 雾、雪、风，全部 平滑：低垂飘移的 雾 掠过地面与悬崖底部，浓密的 雪 被阵风横向吹动，gusting 风 拖曳 雾 与 雪，撕扯 呼吸白雾，灾难被风暴半遮半掩并吞没。
10. SECONDARY ACTION 以 每两帧步进 呈现——ANA 与 UMAI 的衣物、头发和 呼吸白雾 猛烈摆动，狼毛泛起波动，深蓝色襁褓包裹轻微移动，岩石撞击和狼群奔跑激起的雪以绘制的粉末状效果在 每两帧步进 下爆开；雾 与 blowing 雪 保持 平滑。
11. LIGHT — 雾 与 雪 中的冷灰色风暴光，平坦、柔和、无方向性，无太阳、无光线、无光束、无 god rays，面部清晰可读。正确的中性 white balance，不是蓝色滤镜，低饱和、去色处理，雪呈柔和的暴风灰白色，雾 呈浅灰色；近乎 BLOODLESS——这是营救，不是撕咬，任何血迹都必须暗淡、低饱和且极少。

镜头 1 — 悬崖上，~50mm，强烈 手持，位于 雾 与 blowing 雪 中的岩壁高处。构图：ANA 单臂攀爬，位于画面 UPPER 部分，深蓝色襁褓中的婴儿紧贴她的胸口，她的靴子伸向一块岩架——在高处 WITH HER 构图，让我们感受到下方的落差。她一脚踩下——岩架以 每两帧步进 呈现 CRACKS 并 BREAKS away，一块 岩板 松脱。猛烈的 制造眩晕感的向下俯摇 跟随岩板穿过 雾 沿悬崖 FALLS，直奔下方远处那个渺小的身影——厄运的 竖向 line，高度就是残酷的机制。在落石处切镜。

硬切至镜头 2 — 悬崖下方，~35mm，强烈 手持，在 UMAI 的视线高度以 LOW 构图。构图（力量交叉）：年幼的 UMAI 在画面中显得渺小，抬头仰望，雾 与 雪 从身旁横吹而过——岩板 从画面 TOP 落入，径直朝她坠下（代表危险的垂直线）——同时一只 狼 从 SIDE LAUNCHES，用肩膀和身体 SLAMS 她（代表救援的水平线），两条线在渺小的孩子身上交叉，将她撞向侧面并脱离危险（嘴不能咬在她身上，是推撞而非撕咬）——随后岩板 CRASHES 进她刚才站立位置的雪地，以 每两帧步进 呈现粉雪爆开。有一拍，两块正在逼近她的深色棱角物体看似 ATTACK——随后空荡的撞击坑表明狼救了她。UMAI 毫发无伤地翻滚到赶来的狼群之中。呈现真实的重量与冲击，全部使用 每两帧步进。

硬切至镜头 3 — BELOW，WIDE，~35mm，强烈 手持。构图（斜向扫动）：狼群涌入，形成一股迅疾的黑色狼群洪流，取自 @[Image 4](image_4)，毛色各异；它们将 UMAI 被带起，进入狼群之间，把她裹挟在洪流中，沿一条强烈的 斜向动势线 穿过雪地，奔入 雾 与 blizzard；UMAI 是被黑暗流动块面吞没的小小身影，前方浅淡的雾白色是她最终消失其中的 留白。狼群奔跑激起的雪以 每两帧步进 爆开。她消失在白茫茫之中。

硬切至镜头 4 — 悬崖上的 ANA，~50mm，强烈 手持，horizon reeling。构图（大小对比，残酷而永久的距离）：ANA 在广阔岩壁高处显得 TINY 而无助，一只手臂抱着深蓝色襁褓中的婴儿，另一只手攀附岩壁；巨大的冰冷悬崖、浅色 雾 与风暴令她显得微不足道；画面最底部的遥远下方，黑色狼群洪流正带着 UMAI 离去——她们之间高耸的垂直距离如今永久存在且无法跨越，失落的 占主导的留白。她 SEES 这一幕，面容以 每两帧步进的碎裂——双眼睁到极致，嘴巴猛然张开，镇定彻底炸裂——她朝正在消失的狼群伸出空闲的手，形成一条永远无法连接的 动势线，并对着风暴 SCREAMS，嘴唇以 每两帧步进 动作：
“UMAI!!! U-MA-AI!!!”
她的呼喊被风撕碎。下方，黑色狼群洪流与她的女儿消失在 雾 与 falling 雪 中。画面停留在她渺小而无助的身影，以及 UMAI 曾经所在的空白雪地。结束。

Audio: NO MUSIC — 阵阵暴风雪的轰鸣、岩石的 CRACK 与摩擦断裂声、岩板砸入雪地的沉重 CRASH、狼的撞击声、狼群奔涌声、ANA 被风吞没的原始撕裂般尖叫。无字幕。仅使用自然的 diegetic sound，绝对无音乐。

title: 惊喜探访故事短片
summary: 用短信、奔跑和见面安排故事转折，让对白与每个镜头的动作互相配合。
use: 适合练习短片分镜、动作连续性和声音描述。
preparation: 准备支持视频生成的工具，先确认可选时长、画幅和声音设置。
steps: 先看视频，再阅读完整提示词，标出每段镜头的时长、主体动作和衔接位置。
替换人物、产品或场景时，同步检查全文的称呼、服装和外观描述，保持前后一致。
按工具支持的时长制作；超过单次时长的内容按镜头拆段，并保留承接动作，最后拼接。
检查人物是否变化、动作是否连贯、声音是否对齐；一次只调整最明显的问题。
lesson: 用时间段约束动作顺序，并同时说明镜头、角色和声音，让前后片段有明确的承接关系。
exercise: 先保留镜头顺序，只替换一个主体或场景。若动作开始不连贯，减少同一段内的动作数量。

卡登：年轻男性，短黑发，白 T 恤外搭黑色夹克，深色牛仔裤，白色运动鞋，棕色背包。温暖的笑容，富有表现力的眼神，自然的表演。

镜头：电影感无人机建立镜头，掠过黄金时段热闹的市中心。汽车在下方行驶，咖啡馆热闹非凡，行人穿过人行横道。镜头平滑俯冲向公园长椅，卡登坐在那里看手机。

一条短信出现。
我到了 ❤️

他疲惫的表情瞬间化作最灿烂的笑容。

她真的来了……
快速插入他抓起背包起身的镜头。

极特写。

只有微笑。

快速的电影感蒙太奇，配以无缝甩镜转场。
他们紧紧拥抱。
他们手牵手大笑着走路。
在餐车前分享薯条。
在广场喂鸽子。
拍搞怪自拍。
她偷走他的帽子跑开。
手持追逐镜头。
他追上了她。
两人笑得停不下来。
他们的手自然交扣的特写。

黄金时段渐渐褪入蓝调时刻。
宽广的天台俯瞰着灯火通明的城市天际线。

微风轻拂她的发丝。
一片宁静。
她不抬头也在微笑。

看着她。

淡出至黑。

有些地方很美。
有些人让它们变得难忘。

promptOriginal:
[CONDITION DEFINITION]
1:1スクエア、15秒、参照画像なし。広大な島全体に港町が高速で組み上がる、シネマティックな高級ミニチュア・ジオラマ形成モンタージュ。方向性は、チープな玩具ではなく、高級な手作りジオラマ、高級コレクタートイ、映画撮影用の精密模型のような質感。可愛らしさ、整理された美しさ、模型ならではの楽しさを残しつつ、島全体が大きく広がる壮大感を出す。明るくクリアな昼光、青い海、白い波、赤・青・白の屋根、木の桟橋、石の岸壁、灯台、橋、運河、丘の上の街並み、複数の港区画を見せる。主役は人物ではなく、巨大な港島ジオラマそのもの。文字、ロゴ、透かし、字幕は不要。

[SHOT/FLOW]
0.0〜3.0秒：
広角の高い俯瞰ショットから開始する。小さな箱庭ではなく、青い海に囲まれた大きな島全体を見せる。何もない島の地形に、海岸線、湾、防波堤、崖、丘、港口、運河、複数の岸壁、橋、主要道路、段差のある街区の輪郭が高速で現れ、まず島と港の大きな骨格が一気に完成する。最初から外海、湾、丘、港の広がりを見せ、こじんまりした印象を避ける。
3.0〜6.5秒：
カメラは広角を保ったまま、ゆるやかに下降しながら港側へ前進する。木の桟橋、石畳、階段、手すり、倉庫、漁具小屋、運河沿いの建物、赤・青・白の屋根の家並み、丘へ続く細い道が、カチッとはまるようにテンポよく組み上がる。寄りすぎず、常に港・丘・外海の奥行きが見える構図にする。
6.5〜10.0秒：
自然な場面転換を入れ、港の中距離ショットへ移る。複数の桟橋、小舟、帆船、係留ロープ、木箱、小型クレーン、街灯、旗、橋、運河、岸壁の石の継ぎ目、桟橋の板などの細部が連続して完成する。ここは形成の快感を最も強く見せる場面だが、小物の寄りだけにせず、広い港区画全体が一気に密度を増していくように見せる。
10.0〜12.5秒：
灯台、丘の上の街並み、複数の港区画、外海へ続く湾を見せる。灯台が完成し、屋根、窓、橋、街灯、船、旗が最後の仕上げとして整い、広大な港島ジオラマが完成形に近づく。ここで島全体のスケール感をもう一度強く見せる。
12.5〜15.0秒：
完成した港島に命が宿る。水面がきらめき、小舟が少し揺れ、旗とロープが風になびき、灯台の光がゆっくり回り、窓や街灯が小さく点灯する。最後は広角で大きく引いた壮大な全景。港, 丘, 灯台, 複数の桟橋, 外海まで含めて, 大きな高級ジオラマ島が可愛らしく息づき始めた余韻で締める。

[CAMERA/EDITING]
カメラは広角を重視し、島全体の広がりを常に感じさせる。開始は高い俯瞰、次に下降前進、港沿いの近接通過、灯台まわりの軽い回り込み、最後は大きく引いた全景。15秒内に2〜3回の自然な場面転換を入れる。寄りカットは入れてよいが、寄りすぎて小さな玩具だけに見えないようにする。前景・中景・遠景を重ね、港、丘、灯台、外海が同時に見える構図を作る。テンポは速く、形成の快感を重視する。単調な直線移動や長い静止は避ける。

[SOUND]
BGMあり、効果音あり。BGMは明るく爽快で、少し冒険感のあるシネマティックな音楽。高級ジオラマが完成していく高揚感を支えるが、派手すぎない。効果音は小さな組み立て音、木や石がはまる音、軽いクリック音、水音、波のさざめき、ロープや旗の音、船のきしみ、遠いカモメ、灯台の小さな機械音。セリフなし、ナレーションなし。

[NEGATIVE]
小さすぎる島、こじんまりした箱庭、安い玩具感、チープなプラスチック感、雑なクラフト感、狭い港、数軒だけの町、スケールのない構図、暗い曇天、濁った海、実物大の巨大人間、人物主役化、文字、ロゴ、透かし、字幕、単調な直線カメラ、完成後に完全静止するだけのラストを避ける。

    - low_tracking_shot_following_behind
    - side_tracking_shot
    - drone_orbit
    - fpv_drone_chase
    - handheld_chase
    - crane_pull_back
    - speed_ramp

subjects:

      - athletic_build

environment:

    - paved_street
    - rooftop_concrete

    - glass_skyscrapers
    - busy_traffic
    - pedestrians
    - street_signs

promptZh:
基本要求
任务：生成视频。镜头具有电影感和动态感，采用大型动画游戏与 Unreal Engine 风格的渲染质感。严格固定参考角色外观、风格与美术方向，优先保证画面冲击力。

摄影
多镜头动态序列，关键动作时全身可见。镜头高度可变，24–35mm 视角。镜头运动包括低位背后跟拍、侧面跟拍、无人机环绕、第一视角无人机追逐、手持追逐、升降镜头后拉、速度变化，以及关键空翻时的慢动作。

主体
一名高水平跑酷运动员，运动型体格；服装与外观保持一致，头发和衣服随运动产生自然变化。

环境
现代写实城市。地面包括铺装街道、混凝土屋顶、金属梁与管道。背景包括玻璃摩天楼、繁忙交通、行人、路牌、桥梁、施工区。光线从温暖日落过渡到蓝调时刻，包含体积光与真实反射。

动作过程
0–3 秒，冲刺起步：爆发但可信的加速，躲避行人，跃过障碍，从路障下滑过。
3–6 秒，翻越与蹬墙跑：越过栏杆，沿建筑墙面奔跑，跃至下一屋顶；动量和落地后的缓冲恢复可信。
6–9 秒，进阶跑酷：双手支撑腾越、精准跳跃、蹬墙转向跳、前空翻；保持平衡，不无故漂浮。
9–12 秒，屋顶穿行：抓金属梁摆荡，沿窄屋顶边缘奔跑，从管道下滑过，跨越屋顶间的大间距。
12–15 秒，最后一跃：到达最高屋顶，自信微笑，向城市天际线纵身跃出，以定格结束。

运动规则
自然节奏中加入戏剧性快慢变化，各阶段连续衔接。重力、重心、惯性与重量转移可信；脚步落点真实，落地有压缩缓冲；衣服、头发有物理运动；禁止无依据的漂浮。

画面规则
动画与照片写实结合；HDR 光线追踪反射、全局照明、柔和光晕、浅景深、电影调色，以及新海诚风格的光线。除慢动作段落外，也要能看清身体动作机制。

声音
高能量电影配乐、同步脚步、掠过的风声、城市环境声、衣料运动音效、金属撞击声、环境混响；无对白。

限制
禁止不自然的物理表现、换装、多个主角、文字、标志。

输出重点
强调电影感场面、准确的跑酷技术动作、角色一致性。

promptOriginal:
1980s film, authentic live-action footage shot on 35mm with heavy grain, vibrant yet gritty saturated colors, practical neon lighting mixed with harsh strobes and fog. Fast chaotic editing packed with abrupt cuts, glass reflections, POV inserts, strobe flashes and dynamic movement to create total disorientation and panic. Real practical squib blood, rubber tentacles and physical stunts. Period-accurate 80s performances: big hair, colorful outfits, leg warmers, exaggerated fear and desperate physicality. Visualized synth atmosphere through pulsing lights and sudden dead silence.
[IMAGE REFERENCES] Generate from scratch a consistent group of five mid-80s young adults with distinctly different looks—tall blonde mullet guy in neon shirt, short chubby dark-curly guy in Hawaiian print, slim big-curled redhead girl in neon dress, athletic black-ponytailed girl in crop top, lanky glasses brunette in pastel polo—in colorful yacht-party fashion and one original giant octopus killer with thick rubber tentacles and gaping beak. All on a neon-drenched luxury yacht in pure practical 1980s slasher style.
[TIMELINE SECOND BY SECOND] 0-3s: [Rapid Disorientation Montage] Quick jarring cuts on the dimly lit yacht deck at night. Neon lights pulsing, five friends laughing and dancing with drinks, music blasting. Inserts: champagne spilling, one girl's smile fading as mist rises from the water, glass reflection briefly showing a massive tentacle that vanishes. Strobe flicker. Laughter dies as engines are dead and no land in sight.
3-6s: [Rising Panic Montage] Fast cuts as panic spreads. Tall blonde runs to the helm, radio smashed. Close-up of broken mic. Two girls huddle near railing, eyes wide, calling names that echo. Low-angle POV gliding through thick fog. Drink glass tips. They split—one to cabins, one to stern. Water reflections show tentacles moving unseen.
6-9s: [First Attack Sequence] Sudden violence, rapid-fire cuts. Giant octopus erupts from foggy water. Quick cuts: massive tentacle lit by strobe, slamming down, bright squib blood spray across pink jacket. Body drops hard on wet deck. Others scream and scatter, slipping. One girl falls. Octopus advances with heavy tentacle movements while neon keeps pulsing.
9-12s: [Full Chaos & Practical Kills] Frenzied montage. Multiple cuts: guy racing for life raft, tentacle appears behind him. Girl hides behind bar, tentacle smashes through, practical blood on counter. Another cornered against cabin wall, lifted and slammed, body slides leaving red streak. Feet scraping, bodies falling, fog swirling around practical gore. Violent strobes. Survivor swings boat hook, dull thud on tentacle.
12-15s: [Climax & Lingering Threat] Fast cuts. Last two desperately lower a life raft. One yanked into fog and water, scream cut short. Final girl turns, face sweat-and-blood covered, backing on slippery deck. Wide shot of yacht littered with bodies under pulsing neon. Octopus rises again, tentacle cracked but massive. She runs into darkness as strobe freezes on the gaping beak. Slight film burn at end.
[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS] Photorealistic 1980s film emulation, heavy natural grain and reel artifacts, authentic practical squib blood and rubber-tentacle stunts, coherent physics with realistic slips and momentum on wet wooden deck.
promptZh:
80 年代电影，真实实拍素材，35mm 拍摄，带有厚重颗粒感，色彩鲜艳但充满粗粝质感，混合了实用霓虹灯光、强烈频闪和雾气。快节奏、混乱的剪辑，充斥着突兀的转场、玻璃反射、第一人称视角插入镜头、频闪闪烁和动态移动，营造出彻底的迷失感与恐慌。使用真实的实拍血浆、橡胶触手和物理特技。符合 80 年代时代特征的表演：大波浪发型、色彩鲜艳的服装、腿套，以及夸张的恐惧感和绝望的肢体动作。通过脉冲灯光和突如其来的死寂，视觉化呈现合成器音乐的氛围。

[图像参考] 从零开始生成一组由 5 名 80 年代中期年轻人组成的固定角色，外观各不相同：高个金发鲻鱼头男生（穿霓虹色衬衫）、矮胖深色卷发男生（穿夏威夷印花衫）、苗条大卷发红发女孩（穿霓虹色连衣裙）、运动型黑色马尾辫女孩（穿露脐上衣）、瘦高戴眼镜棕发女孩（穿浅色 Polo 衫），身着色彩鲜艳的游艇派对服饰，以及一只原创的巨型章鱼杀手，拥有厚实的橡胶触手和张开的喙。所有场景均设定在霓虹闪烁的豪华游艇上，呈现纯正的 20 世纪 80 年代砍杀电影风格。

[秒级时间轴] 0-3 秒：[快速迷失蒙太奇] 夜间昏暗游艇甲板上的快速、刺耳的剪辑。霓虹灯闪烁，五个朋友笑着跳舞，音乐震耳欲聋。插入镜头：香槟洒出，一个女孩的笑容在水面升起的薄雾中逐渐消失，玻璃反射中短暂出现一只巨大的触手随即消失。频闪闪烁。引擎熄火，四周不见陆地，笑声戛然而止。

3-6 秒：[恐慌升级蒙太奇] 恐慌蔓延时的快速剪辑。高个金发男跑向舵位，无线电被砸碎。破碎麦克风的特写。两个女孩蜷缩在栏杆旁，双眼圆睁，呼喊着彼此的名字，回声阵阵。穿过浓雾的低角度第一人称视角。酒杯倾倒。他们分散开来，一个跑向船舱，一个跑向船尾。水面反射出触手在暗处移动。

6-9 秒：[首次袭击片段] 突如其来的暴力，快速连贯的剪辑。巨型章鱼从雾气弥漫的水中冲出。快速剪辑：频闪灯照亮巨大的触手，猛烈拍下，鲜红的血浆喷溅在粉色夹克上。身体重重摔在湿漉漉的甲板上。其他人尖叫着四散奔逃，脚下打滑。一个女孩摔倒。章鱼在霓虹灯持续闪烁中，伴随着沉重的触手动作逼近。

9-12 秒：[全面混乱与实拍杀戮] 疯狂的蒙太奇。多次剪辑：男生奔向救生筏，触手出现在他身后。女孩躲在吧台后，触手击穿吧台，吧台上留下真实的血迹。另一个人被逼到船舱墙角，被举起并重重摔下，身体滑过留下红色血痕。脚部摩擦声，身体倒地，浓雾在真实的血腥场面周围缭绕。猛烈的频闪。幸存者挥动船钩，沉闷地击中触手。

12-15 秒：[高潮与挥之不去的威胁] 快速剪辑。最后两名幸存者拼命放下救生筏。一人被拽入雾中和水里，尖叫戛然而止。最终女孩转身，脸上满是汗水和血迹，在湿滑的甲板上后退。广角镜头展现霓虹灯下横七竖八的尸体和游艇。章鱼再次浮现，触手虽有裂痕但依旧庞大。她跑向黑暗，频闪定格在张开的巨喙上。结尾处带一点胶片烧灼感。

[风格与质感加成] 照相写实的 80 年代胶片质感，浓重的自然颗粒和胶片瑕疵，真实的实拍血浆和橡胶触手特技，湿滑木质甲板上真实的打滑与惯性物理效果。

REFERENCE ROLES
Image 1 defines the environment architecture only — arched timber shipyard framework, hanging pulleys, ropes, beams and tool fragments. Reinterpret entirely as bold ink linework and flat color. Ignore its painterly rendering and lighting.
Image 2 defines the character's full silhouette, wardrobe (apron, tool belt, mallet), proportions and stance, for use across a complete 360-degree rotation.
Reinterpret entirely as bold ink linework and flat color. Ignore its original pose beyond providing the base standing silhouette.

Create a 15-second, 16:9 seamless-loop 360-degree character turnaround sequence titled THE SHIPWRIGHT, part of THE LAST KEEL adventure series. Draw from graphic-novel ink linework, bold crosshatch shading, dynamic diagonal panel-assembly cuts, adventure-pulp poster energy, hard silhouette action reveals, ink-splatter accents, warm ochre, rust and umber palette. Aim for 65% swashbuckling build-up energy and 35% rugged craftsman grit: bold, propulsive, satisfying. Never soft gradients, painterly blur, slow atmospheric dissolve, static stillness.  Build the sequence as a continuous 360-degree character turntable rotation with the shipyard environment assembling around him in rhythmic bursts. The shipwright from Image 2 rotates smoothly and continuously on a fixed spot for one full turn, occupying the central frame throughout. At four evenly spaced points in the rotation, hard comic-panel cuts snap new environment fragments from Image 1 into place around him, timber beams locking in, ropes and pulleys dropping into frame, tool-belt items appearing one by one, the mallet materializing in his hand, until the full scene and his complete gear are assembled by the final quarter-turn. The final frame must exactly match the opening frame in pose, framing and assembled environment, so the rotation completes a perfect seamless loop with no jump or freeze.

TYPOGRAPHY & CREDITS: All on-screen text must remain perfectly sharp, stable and legible at all times. Use only the exact text provided. No Chinese characters, no garbled, warped, stretched or misspelled text. Each role and each name appears only once per loop cycle. Label: "THE SHIPWRIGHT" bold condensed comic-lettering style. Subtitle: "THE LAST KEEL" smaller wide-tracked label, always paired directly beneath the main label, never near the character. Hierarchy: bold name label + smaller wide-tracked series tag, both treated as a single unit that never overlaps or touches the character silhouette at any point.

ANIMATION STYLE: the label unit draws on large and centered in open negative space at roughly the 4-second mark, ink strokes forming fast, held briefly at full size then a quick ink-drag transition pulls and shrinks the entire unit into the bottom-right corner by the 6-second mark, where it settles small and static like a printed watermark mark for the remainder of the loop. Once settled in the corner, it stays fixed, minimal and out of the character's rotation path for the rest of the sequence, then wipes off with a brief ink-splatter flash just before the loop point so the final frame stays text-free and matches the opening frame exactly. Hold the label fully formed and motionless for 0.9–1.3 seconds both at its centered appearance and once settled in the corner.  Vary the transitions aggressively and mix freely from this dense palette, using four of them as the primary build-reveal cuts synchronized to the quarter-turns of the rotation: panel-slam cuts, diagonal panel-split reconfigurations, silhouette action wipes, ink-splatter flash cuts, crosshatch wipes, hard color-block cuts, whip-pan zoom punches, black-frame impact cuts, action-line radial wipes, comic-gutter slice cuts. Keep every transition crisp, fast, propulsive and strictly collage-driven. No soft dissolves, fluid morphs, gentle fades or organic morphing. The character's rotation itself must stay smooth and continuous underneath the hard-cut environment assembly and the label's corner-settling motion.

Instrumentation: driving snare rolls, brass stabs, low horn hits, plucked strings, taut percussion accents, four rhythmic "construction hit" accents synced to each quarter-turn assembly cut, plus a distinct ink-drag whoosh synced to the label's move into the corner.

0s: opening downbeat with snare roll.
4s: label draws on centered, brass stab underscores it. 6s: ink-drag whoosh as the label shrinks into the corner; first construction-hit accent as beams lock in.
8s: second construction-hit as tools appear.
12s: full rhythm and third construction-hit as the mallet materializes.
15s: rhythm resolves back to the opening downbeat, label wiped clean, completing the loop with no freeze.
Keep it driving, bold and propulsive. Never orchestral bombast without rhythm, cheerful melody, ambient pads. Do not imitate any existing melody.  Add precise, short transition whooshes and impact hits synchronized to each quarter-turn construction cut and both label movements. Keep them designed, restrained and loop-consistent so the audio also cycles cleanly.

完全以 粗墨线条 和 flat color 重新诠释。除用于提供基础 standing 轮廓 外，忽略其原始姿势。

promptOriginal:
Photorealistic cinematic 1950s American diner, chrome stools, red vinyl, neon glow and checkerboard floor, shot with modern lived-in realism and soft natural window light. Subtle handheld texture, warm practicals, rich period detail, heavy film grain.

0-4s: [Medium Wide] A striking young woman in her early 20s sits alone at the counter, calm and slightly amused, slowly sipping a tall thick milkshake through a straw. Behind her a young waitress in classic uniform approaches with a tray of eggs and bacon in one hand and a full glass coffee pot in the other. An older lady starts rising from a nearby booth.

4-8s: [Dynamic Tracking] The older lady collides hard into the waitress. Tray, plate, eggs, bacon and coffee pot explode upward in chaotic slow motion. Coffee erupts into long liquid ribbons and perfect suspended droplets. Camera immediately begins a smooth continuous orbit around the impact. Time locks completely at the peak of the spill. Every face freezes in pure shock. Only the girl at the counter keeps moving, completely unfazed.

8-17s: [Slow 360° Orbital] Camera glides in a full elegant orbit through the frozen diner. Coffee hangs in mid-air as glassy ribbons and spheres with perfect volume and surface tension. Bacon strips, eggs and the spinning tray float weightlessly. Patrons and waitress remain locked in startled expressions. The girl at the counter takes one slow, deliberate sip, eyes half-lidded, almost bored, while the entire frozen world (except her) begins an elegant reverse: every droplet, every piece of food and every person rewinds smoothly back to the exact starting positions.

17-24s: [Medium Shot] Rewind lands perfectly. Waitress stands balanced again with tray and coffee pot. The girl lifts her eyes, raises two fingers in a small casual gesture and softly calls the waitress by name. title: 穿越历史的列车短片
summary: 以列车乘客视角连接不同时代的景象，练习环境转场与持续的观察视角。
use: 适合练习短片分镜、动作连续性和声音描述。
preparation: 准备支持视频生成的工具，先确认可选时长、画幅和声音设置。
steps: 先看视频，再阅读完整提示词，标出每段镜头的时长、主体动作和衔接位置。
替换人物、产品或场景时，同步检查全文的称呼、服装和外观描述，保持前后一致。
按工具支持的时长制作；超过单次时长的内容按镜头拆段，并保留承接动作，最后拼接。
检查人物是否变化、动作是否连贯、声音是否对齐；一次只调整最明显的问题。
lesson: 用时间段约束动作顺序，并同时说明镜头、角色和声音，让前后片段有明确的承接关系。
exercise: 先保留镜头顺序，只替换一个主体或场景。若动作开始不连贯，减少同一段内的动作数量。

promptOriginal:
Create a 30-second vertical 9:16 first-person smartphone video, filmed by one standing passenger inside an extremely crowded maglev commuter train. One continuous take only: no cuts, jump cuts, fades, dissolves, overlays, double exposure, scene resets, or artificial transitions.

The same train, same carriage, same passengers, same camera, and same interior remain consistent throughout. The camera is a cheap smartphone held at chest height, one-handed while the other hand grips a pole. The phone is never visible. Footage is crooked, shaky, partially blocked by shoulders, and realistically imperfect: rolling-shutter distortion, autofocus hunting, exposure fluctuations, blown highlights, noisy shadows, compression artifacts, motion smear, and no stabilization or cinematic movement.

The camera always looks through the left-side window at roughly 90° to the train's direction. The train always moves forward and the outside world flows from front to back.

Timeline

0–2s — Present Day
Ordinary modern weekday morning: glass buildings, traffic, pedestrians passing outside. Tired commuters barely react. Announcement: “Next stop: 1944.” The train suddenly accelerates; passengers grab poles and sway.

2–4s — Time Turbulence
Modern scenery is physically swallowed by a dense silver-gray temporal mist tunnel. It has real depth, airflow, parallax, and particles. Old newspapers, yellowed pages, and radio-static-like fragments fly naturally from front to back. Carriage lights flicker. This is a real tunnel, not a transition effect.

4–8s — June 1944, Normandy
The mist clears as the train physically emerges beside the Normandy coast. Gray dawn, naval ships, landing craft, barrage balloons, distant explosions, smoke, and soldiers as distant silhouettes in the surf. No graphic violence. Passengers become solemn and tense.

8–9s — Time Turbulence
Parchment fragments and quill-like light streaks rush past the window. Radio-static texture and distant voices. Announcement: “Next stop: 1789.”

9–13s — May 1789, Versailles
The train emerges beside Versailles. Stone walls, wrought-iron gates, horse-drawn carriages, formally dressed representatives, and large crowds. Warm golden morning light. Church bells and murmuring voices. Atmosphere of expectation and historical change.

13–14s — Time Turbulence
Flying pamphlets and paper fragments fill the temporal mist. Announcement: “Next stop: 1776.”

14–18s — July 1776, Philadelphia
The train emerges beside a red-brick bell-tower building and crowded stone square. A bell rings, representatives exit, a proclamation is read, papers flutter, and the crowd celebrates quietly. Warm summer evening light. A passenger smiles and softly says: “Look.”

18–19s — Time Turbulence
Rough dark mist, ash-like particles, glowing embers, distant horns. Announcement: “Next stop: 1184 BC.”

19–23s — April 1184 BC, Troy
The train emerges at night beside a massive fortified city. Burning walls, smoke, a huge wooden horse being pulled through a damaged gate, shield-bearing silhouettes, and ships along the shore. Convey war only through fire, smoke, silhouettes, and scale. No blood, injuries, or graphic violence. Passengers lean toward the window, visibly grave.

23–24s — Time Turbulence
Golden swirling sand replaces the mist. Luminous fragments resembling ancient symbols and distant chanting pass through the window. Announcement: “Next stop: 2500 BC.”

24–28s — Approximately 2500 BC, Giza
The turbulence clears to reveal a gigantic unfinished pyramid under intense white-gold desert sunlight. Thousands of workers haul limestone blocks up massive ramps using ropes, rollers, and levers. Supervisors stand above; boats move along the distant Nile. Immense scale and photorealistic ancient construction. A passenger whispers: “Ohh.”

28–30s — Ending
The train keeps moving beside the enormous pyramid. Dust floats through the sunlight; distant workers continue their labor. Every passenger is silent and stunned. At approximately 29.7s, the announcement quietly says: “Welcome to 2500 BC.” The train continues moving and the video ends naturally—no fade or cut.

Physics, Lighting & Sound

Passengers, hand loops, clothing, backpacks, and loose objects react naturally to acceleration and turbulence. Keep the same people and interior throughout.

Lighting changes physically with each era: cool modern morning → gray-blue Normandy dawn → warm Versailles morning → warm Philadelphia evening → orange-red Troy firelight → intense white-gold Giza sunlight. Light always enters from the left window and illuminates passengers naturally.

Use only diegetic sound: maglev hum, mechanical rattling, vibrating poles, compressed phone-mic audio, plus era-specific ambience. Every time jump includes a brief radio-static scan and historical echoes before naturally becoming the new environment's sound.

Critical Rules

Single uninterrupted shot. Same train. Same passengers. Same phone. Forward motion only. Left-window view only. Every time jump must be achieved by physically entering and exiting a real 3D temporal-mist tunnel. No editing or compositing.

All historical environments must be photorealistic and period-appropriate. Do not show recognizable famous historical figures in facial close-up. Keep Normandy and Troy non-graphic. The footage must feel like an accidental, low-quality smartphone recording—not a polished movie.

镜头接近垂直俯拍。主角沿楼宇之间的空间快速下降，身体由前倾逐渐调整为面向下方，双臂保持展开以稳定方向。

随着主角下降，街道、车辆和十字路口迅速显现。巨型黑色圆形弹性装置从画面下方出现，彩虹灯环照亮周围建筑。

主角的下降轨迹必须准确对准黑色弹性面的圆心，不能偏向灯环或撞向建筑。

00:04.80-00:05.50｜命中中心

主角身体落在黑色弹性面正中心。弹性面受到冲击后明显向下形成深凹，彩虹灯环保持固定，装置不能破裂。

短暂压缩后，弹性面以巨大力量恢复原状，将主角垂直向上弹出。

必须清楚表现“接触—下陷—压缩—回弹”四个阶段，不能在接触前提前反向飞行。

00:05.50-00:08.20｜高速反弹与空中翻腾

摄影者仍站在屋顶护墙边。画面底部短暂出现摄影者的双脚，强化真实第一视角和高空距离。

主角从圆形装置中心高速升起，沿原来的垂直路线返回屋顶。摄影机从垂直向下持续向上抬起，跟随主角穿过城市楼宇之间的空间。

主角升空后收紧腰腹，双膝靠近胸口，双臂抱住小腿，形成紧凑团身，在空中完成连续快速翻腾。不要锁定具体翻转方向，以自然连续旋转为准。

主角接近屋顶高度时开始打开身体：松开双腿、抬起头寻找屋顶、双脚转向下方，双臂向两侧展开保持平衡。

00:08.20-00:09.40｜返回屋顶

主角高速接近镜头，从屋顶护墙外侧越回停机坪。双脚同时接触绿色地面，膝盖和髋部深度弯曲，以低位蹲姿吸收落地冲击。

落地必须具有明显重量：鞋底或脚掌接触、腿部压缩、身体下沉、轻微反弹恢复。不能站直着轻飘落地。

摄影者快速后退半步，避免主角撞上镜头，同时继续保持正面近景。

00:09.40-00:10.00｜真实庆祝

主角从蹲姿快速站起，兴奋地看向镜头，张口欢呼。屋顶朋友冲进画面，举着手机围过来，拍肩、挥拳、大声庆祝。

Environment:

真实夜间手机曝光，高楼具有准确透视和尺度。下落阶段风声增强，城市灯光形成自然运动拖影；主角返回屋顶时速度极快，但人体轮廓仍然清晰。

title: 多人音乐视频的角色与编舞
summary: 分别用图片固定人物身份、用视频提供节奏参考，练习多人动作和镜头配合。
use: 适合练习短片分镜、动作连续性和声音描述。
preparation: 准备支持视频生成的工具，先确认可选时长、画幅和声音设置。提示词涉及参考素材时，准备对应的人物、产品或场景图；提到音频时也需提供自己的音轨。
steps: 先看视频，再阅读完整提示词，标出每段镜头的时长、主体动作和衔接位置。
替换人物、产品或场景时，同步检查全文的称呼、服装和外观描述，保持前后一致。
按工具支持的时长制作；超过单次时长的内容按镜头拆段，并保留承接动作，最后拼接。
检查人物是否变化、动作是否连贯、声音是否对齐；一次只调整最明显的问题。
lesson: 用时间段约束动作顺序，并同时说明镜头、角色和声音，让前后片段有明确的承接关系。

promptOriginal:
Create a music video; the images are exclusive appearance references and @[blackout video] is the editorial clock. Keep four distinct members, continuous choreography, and an open rightward exit.

Use @[image1] only for Vocal 1's final identity and wardrobe.
Use @[image2] only for Vocal 2's final identity and wardrobe.
Use @[image3] only for Vocal 3's final identity and wardrobe.
Use @[image4] only for Vocal 4's final identity and wardrobe.
Use @[blackout video]  only for vocal order, lip sync, hits and mix; add no words or voices.
Only four performers exist: one instance each of @[image1], @[image2], @[image3] and @[image4]; no doubles, extras, reflections, shadow figures, partial bodies or spare limbs.

LOOK + WORLD: Textured hand-painted 2D anime K-pop video with silhouettes, paper grain. Cycle through a crimson tunnel, cream-coral room, blue-gray rooftop, silver workshop and matte-black moon stage; nonreflective floors, red, cream and cyan light, wide-lens depth, mist.
ACTION + CAMERA: Sharp weighted idol choreography locks to 148 BPM subdivisions. Cut on action with pose-matched set swaps and one stutter edit; rise from solo snaps through a three-cut burst into the chorus, then carry rightward without a final pose.
VFX SYSTEM: Red-cyan light smears, tape-bloom halos and flat geometric flash panels appear only in P06, P07 and P11, never covering faces or lip sync.
SOUND: Use @[blackout video]  unchanged: four distinct female vocals, syncopated snares, 16th-note hi-hats, synth stabs, sub-bass drops and frame-drum pulse; preserve tape saturation and plate reverb.

BEATS:
P01: Low front 3/4 WS, track: exactly four performers; Vocal 1 leads in the crimson tunnel with cap taps and elbow punches while the other three dance behind her.
P02: Dutch profile MCU, push: Vocal 2 dances alone in the cream-coral room through alternating shoulder switches.
P03: High front 3/4 FS, crane: Vocal 3 dances alone on the rooftop and lands a fast heel-toe chain.
P04: Ground frontal MLS, tilt: Vocal 4 dances alone in the silver workshop and drops into a wide weighted step.
P05: Frontal WS, locked: exactly four performers form one diamond in the crimson tunnel and load crossed forearms on the selected snare.
P06: High front 3/4 WS, pull: exactly the same four burst-cut to the cream-coral room, open their elbows and widen the diamond as coral-white panels flash, then vanish.
P07: Low frontal WS, push: exactly the same four burst-cut to the rooftop and release into a low stance; red-cyan smears rise from four floor contacts, then dissolve.
P08: Rear 3/4 WS, track: exactly the same four cut to the silver workshop; three torso hits break the diamond and each member enters her assigned lane.
P09: Top-down WS, crane: exactly four complete bodies kick-cut to the matte-black moon stage, cross in one X, two front and two rear, then open into one line.
P10: Dutch side FS, track: exactly four members travel screen right through the chorus hook; the only stutter repeats one motion slice, never people or body parts.
P11: Low front 3/4 WS, push: exactly four members connect an arm wave, chest hit and stomp beneath the full moon; its tape-bloom halo swells clear of faces, then settles.
P12: Front 3/4 WS, pull: exactly the same four turn clockwise and dance screen right as the world cools into a moon-blue horizon; cut in motion, no final pose.

制作一支音乐视频；这些图像仅作为外观参考，@[blackout video] 是剪辑时间基准。保持四名成员清晰独立、编舞连续，并保留向右侧离场的开放式结尾。

@[blackout video]  仅用于确定演唱顺序、lip sync、重音点和混音；不要添加任何文字或人声。
只能存在四名表演者：@[image1]、@[image2]、@[image3] 和 @[image4] 各一人；不得出现分身、群众演员、倒影、影子人形、残缺身体或多余肢体。

LOOK + WORLD：带有剪影和纸张颗粒质感的手绘纹理 2D 动漫 K-pop 视频。在深红隧道、奶油珊瑚色房间、蓝灰色屋顶、银色工坊和哑黑月亮舞台之间循环切换；地面不反光，采用红色、奶油色和青色灯光、广角镜头纵深 与薄雾。
ACTION + 镜头：有力而干脆的偶像编舞严格契合 148 BPM 的细分节拍。按动作衔接切镜，配合姿势匹配的场景切换和一次 stutter edit；从单人快速动作推进，经三次快速剪切进入副歌，随后继续向右移动，不以最终定格姿势收尾。
VFX SYSTEM：红青色光迹、tape-bloom 光晕和平面几何闪光面板仅在 P06、P07 和 P11 中出现，绝不遮挡面部或 lip sync。
SOUND：保持 @[blackout video]  不变：四种清晰不同的女声、切分军鼓、十六分音符 hi-hats、synth stabs、超低频下落 和 框鼓脉冲节奏；保留 tape saturation 和 plate reverb。

节拍：
P01：Low front 3/4 WS, track：恰好四名表演者；Vocal 1 在深红隧道中领舞，做点帽檐和肘击动作，另外三人在她身后起舞。
P02：倾斜侧面中近景, 推进：Vocal 2 独自在奶油珊瑚色房间中起舞，连续交替切换双肩动作。
P03：High front 3/4 FS, crane：Vocal 3 独自在屋顶起舞，并完成一组快速的脚跟脚尖连步。
P04：贴地正面中远景, 摇镜：Vocal 4 独自在银色工坊中起舞，并下沉进入宽阔有力的步伐。
P05：Frontal WS, locked：恰好四名表演者在深红隧道中组成一个菱形队形，并在指定的军鼓重音上蓄力交叉前臂。
P06：High front 3/4 WS, pull：完全相同的四人通过快速爆发式剪切切换到奶油珊瑚色房间，打开双肘并扩大菱形队形；珊瑚白面板闪现后消失。
P07：低位正面远景, 推进：完全相同的四人通过快速爆发式剪切切换到屋顶，并释放动作进入低位姿态；红青色光迹从四个地面接触点升起，随后消散。
P08：Rear 3/4 WS, track：完全相同的四人切换到银色工坊；三次躯干重击动作打破菱形队形，每名成员进入各自指定的移动线路。
P09：俯拍远景, crane：恰好四具完整身体通过踢腿动作剪切至哑黑月亮舞台，交叉形成一个 X，前方两人、后方两人，随后展开成一条直线。
P10：倾斜侧面全景, track：恰好四名成员伴随副歌 hook 向 screen right 移动；唯一一次 stutter 仅重复一个动作切片，绝不重复人物或身体部位。
P11：Low front 3/4 WS, 推进：恰好四名成员在满月下连贯完成手臂波浪、胸部重击和跺脚动作；月亮的 tape-bloom 光晕在避开面部的位置膨胀，随后稳定下来。
P12：Front 3/4 WS, pull：完全相同的四人顺时针转身，并朝 screen right 起舞，世界逐渐冷却为月蓝色地平线；在动作中切断，不以最终定格姿势收尾。

promptOriginal:
MiniMax H3 Prompt:
@[ref img] is the sole visual authority for Kaze, the football, the complete player-stats interface, typography, numbers, icons, colors, lighting, layout, and vertical composition. Animate this exact screen without redesigning it. Preserve all existing labels and final stat values.
[Goal]
Create a polished 15-second anime sports-game player stats screen opening. Use one continuous, locked, straight-on full-screen composition with no camera movement, cuts, cropping, or perspective distortion.
[Sequence]
0–2.2 seconds: Begin from near-black teal. A faint horizontal scanner passes downward, revealing Kaze’s silhouette and the outer edges of the interface. Fine particles and dim mint circuitry flicker awake.
2.2–5.5 seconds: The header, KAZE nameplate, role badge, level panel, and overall panel resolve through clean line-draw animations. Kaze emerges fully from shadow, takes a controlled breath, subtly shifts her shoulders and raised arm into the referenced pose, then fixes an intense gaze toward the viewer. Her hair, ribbons, and loose clothing react naturally to a growing current of wind. The football begins a slow, stable rotation beside her hand.
5.5–10.8 seconds: The large overall score counts rapidly upward and lands precisely on 92. The level settles on 46. Each attribute bar fills smoothly from left to right in sequence—Speed 93, Power 91, Control 88, Stamina 90, Agility 94, Technique 89—each landing with a restrained mint pulse. The radar chart draws outward from its center and locks into the exact final polygon. Skill cards activate from top to bottom; their icons flare briefly while the ACTIVE and ULTIMATE states illuminate.
10.8–13.3 seconds: The player ID strip and bottom navigation fade and slide into their exact final positions. The wind energy around Kaze accelerates clockwise, wrapping around the rotating ball and sweeping behind her body with layered luminous trails. Kaze tightens her hand, leans slightly into the current, and gives one natural blink; preserve her identity, anatomy, costume, and right-side placement.
13.3–15 seconds: The energy arc reaches a bright controlled crest, then settles into a living idle pulse. Hold the fully assembled screen matching @[ref img] exactly. Kaze continues subtle breathing; hair and ribbons drift, the football rotates slowly, particles shimmer, and all stats remain stable and readable.
Use crisp premium game-UI motion, clean 2D anime character animation, subtle depth between Kaze and the interface, and stable legible typography. Keep every panel, icon, label, number, and geometric boundary fixed once revealed. Do not introduce new text, extra characters, additional objects, logos, captions, or UI elements.
Audio: low electronic boot hum, delicate scanning ticks, short confirmation tones as values lock, rising airy wind around the ball, soft cloth movement, and one refined completion chime. No dialogue and no music.

MiniMax H3 提示词：
@[ref img] 是 Kaze、足球、完整球员数据界面、字体、数字、图标、颜色、光照、布局和竖向构图的唯一视觉依据。为这个完全相同的画面制作动画，不要重新设计。保留所有现有标签和最终数据值。

制作一个精致的 15 秒动漫体育游戏球员数据界面开场。使用一个连续、locked、straight-on 全屏 构图，不得有 镜头 运动、切镜、cropping 或 透视 distortion。

0–2.2 秒：从近乎黑色的蓝绿色开始。一条微弱的水平扫描线向下掠过，显现 Kaze 的剪影和界面外缘。细小粒子和暗淡的薄荷绿色电路闪烁苏醒。

5.5–10.8 秒：大型综合评分数字快速向上计数，并精准停在 92。等级稳定在 46。各项属性条依次从左向右平滑填充——Speed 93、Power 91、Control 88、Stamina 90、Agility 94、Technique 89——每项停定时伴随克制的薄荷绿色脉冲。雷达图从中心向外绘制，并锁定为完全一致的最终多边形。技能卡从上到下依次激活；图标短暂闪亮，同时 ACTIVE 和 ULTIMATE 状态点亮。

13.3–15 秒：能量弧达到明亮而受控的峰值，随后稳定为富有生命感的待机脉冲。保持完整组装后的画面与 @[ref img] 完全一致。Kaze 继续轻微呼吸；头发和缎带缓缓飘动，足球缓慢旋转，粒子闪烁，所有数据保持稳定且清晰可读。

title: 游戏角色出场介绍模板
summary: 从细节、背影、面部到全身依次展示角色，练习四段镜头的节奏与身份一致性。
use: 适合练习短片分镜、动作连续性和声音描述。
preparation: 准备支持视频生成的工具，先确认可选时长、画幅和声音设置。提示词涉及参考素材时，准备对应的人物、产品或场景图；提到音频时也需提供自己的音轨。
steps: 先看视频，再阅读完整提示词，标出每段镜头的时长、主体动作和衔接位置。
替换人物、产品或场景时，同步检查全文的称呼、服装和外观描述，保持前后一致。
按工具支持的时长制作；超过单次时长的内容按镜头拆段，并保留承接动作，最后拼接。
检查人物是否变化、动作是否连贯、声音是否对齐；一次只调整最明显的问题。
lesson: 用时间段约束动作顺序，并同时说明镜头、角色和声音，让前后片段有明确的承接关系。
exercise: 先保留镜头顺序，只替换一个主体或场景。若动作开始不连贯，减少同一段内的动作数量。

promptOriginal:
Use @[char ref] as the sole character reference. Preserve the exact identity, face, body proportions, hairstyle, outfit, colors, materials and overall silhouette of the character throughout the entire video. Do not redesign, simplify or replace any defining visual features.
Create a cinematic character introduction focused on presence, silhouette, attitude and controlled motion.
0–4s
Begin with a close shot of a defining lower-body or detail element such as boots, shoes, feet, hands, clothing hem or an important accessory. The character enters frame or settles into position. The camera slowly tracks upward while hair, clothing and secondary elements move naturally in the wind or environment.
4–8s
Reveal more of the body with a medium or medium-wide shot from the back, side or three-quarter angle. The character stands in a calm, composed way inside the environment. The camera makes a smooth orbit, arc or lateral move to gradually reveal the character’s face and silhouette.
8–12s
Move into a tight cinematic portrait or upper-body shot. The character performs one subtle signature action that fits their personality, such as lifting the chin, turning the head, adjusting clothing, brushing hair aside, opening a hand, looking toward camera, or shifting posture. Keep the motion minimal and intentional. The expression should match the character’s vibe.
12–15s
End with a strong full-body hero shot that clearly presents the entire design and silhouette. Use a low-angle, eye-level or slightly dramatic framing depending on the character’s personality. The character settles into a natural final pose and holds it confidently for a clean final reveal.
VISUAL DIRECTION
Premium cinematic presentation. Match the visual medium and rendering style of @[char ref]. Emphasize clean silhouette, elegant staging, subtle secondary motion, believable hair and cloth movement, strong composition, atmospheric depth and polished lighting. The scene should feel like a high-end anime, game or film character introduction.
CAMERA
Use a clear progression from detail reveal to partial reveal to face reveal to full-body hero reveal. Camera movement should be smooth, controlled and intentional. Avoid chaotic motion.
ENVIRONMENT
Place the character in a fitting environment that supports their identity and mood. The background should enhance the character without distracting from them.
promptZh:
将 @[char ref] 作为唯一的角色参考。在整段视频中保留角色完全一致的身份、面容、身体比例、发型、服装、色彩、材质和整体 轮廓。不要重新设计、简化或替换任何标志性视觉特征。
制作一段电影级角色介绍，重点展现存在感、轮廓、态度和受控的动作。
0–4s
从展现下半身标志性元素或细节元素的 近景 开始，例如 靴子、鞋子、脚部、手部、衣摆 或重要配饰。角色进入 画面 或站定。镜头 缓慢向上 跟随移动，同时头发、衣物和次要元素在风或环境中自然摆动。
4–8s
使用从背面、侧面或 四分之三侧面角度 拍摄的 中景或中远景，展现更多身体部分。角色以冷静、沉着的姿态站在环境中。镜头 进行平滑的 环绕、弧线移动 或 横向移动，逐渐揭示角色的脸部和 轮廓。
8–12s
进入 紧凑的电影感人像 或 上半身镜头。角色完成一个符合其个性的细微标志性动作，例如抬起下巴、转头、整理衣物、拨开头发、张开手掌、看向 镜头 或调整姿势。动作应保持克制且目的明确。表情应符合角色的 气质。
12–15s
以强有力的 全身主角镜头 收尾，清晰呈现完整设计和 轮廓。根据角色个性使用 低角度、平视 或 略带戏剧感的构图。角色自然进入最终姿势，并自信地保持，为最终揭晓留下干净利落的画面。
视觉要求
高品质电影级呈现。匹配 @[char ref] 的视觉媒介和 渲染风格。强调清晰的 轮廓、优雅的场面调度、细微的 伴随动作、可信的头发与布料运动、强有力的构图、空气透视层次 和精致 光线。场景应呈现高端 动漫、游戏 或 电影 角色介绍的质感。
镜头
使用从 细节展示 到 局部展示、再到 面部展示，最终到 全身主角展示 的清晰递进。镜头 运动 应流畅、受控且目的明确。避免混乱的运动。
环境
将角色置于符合其身份和情绪的环境中。背景 应增强角色表现，同时避免喧宾夺主。

promptOriginal:
Tried Minimax H3 on @DomoAI_ 

Prompt

Here’s a production-ready prompt rewritten for **the girl in your image**, with a **different graphic language** and **different typography**. Her look stays locked to the picture. Structure stays 13 cuts / 16:9 / 24fps.

---

**PROMPT**

Create an explosive, motion-graphics-driven character reveal trailer in 16:9, exactly 13 distinct cuts, 24fps, total 15.00s.

CHARACTER (lock this design; never redesign):
Anime streetwear girl from the reference still. Twin high buns of vivid mint-teal hair with long flowing tails and warm orange/gold streaks. Messy side-swept bangs. Large orange over-ear headphones with mint accents and a small logo plate. Sharp amber-orange eyes, one eye winking. Playful open-mouth grin. Oversized color-block windbreaker: navy body, vivid orange sleeves, white ribbed cuffs, silver zippers, circular teal tech buttons, a teal utility pocket on the sleeve. Orange cropped turtleneck under the open jacket. Light-wash ripped denim shorts, thick orange belt with a silver buckle. Navy thigh-high socks with orange ribbed cuffs and an orange X stitch on the left shin. Chunky white sneakers with orange details. Preserve exact face, proportions, hairstyle, outfit, materials, accessories and colors in every frame.

This film is 80% bold graphic design in motion and 20% character action. Graphic language is **retro OS chrome + music-player UI**, not ice/frost/barcode-lock. Use slamming window frames, title bars, close/minimize widgets, equalizer bars, waveforms, progress ticks, folder tiles, cursor arrows, CRT scanlines, pixel shatter, vinyl-ring stamps, music-note particles, media-player transport icons. Palette: mint teal, vivid orange, navy, cream-white, silver. Style: premium AAA motion-graphics title sequence × streetwear campaign film × Windows-era media player. Every graphic element moves fast and snaps hard on the beat.

CUT 01 | 0.00–1.00s — Pure graphics: a mint title-bar slams onto a cream field, an orange CLOSE widget punches the corner, two navy window borders wipe in. Tiny equalizer ticks and a progress strip flicker. The letters **P** then **LAY** punch in one after another with heavy impact shake.

CUT 02 | 1.00–2.00s — The **A** becomes a headphone cup: extreme close-up of her amber eye inside the orange earcup, glancing up; RGB split flash, then the cup shatters into flat mint/orange tiles.

CUT 03 | 2.00–3.10s — Navy frame with enormous cream **PLAY**. She sprints in from frame left and power-slides across the baseline of the type, speed lines and orange streaks trailing, shards of the letters kicked up like sparks. Whip-pan out.

CUT 04 | 3.10–4.00s — A giant retro media-player waveform explodes across the frame as a thick mint-and-orange audio spectrum bends into a tunnel. She bursts through the center of the waveform at full speed, briefly breaking into three stroboscopic motion trails behind her. Each trail leaves behind chunky navy equalizer blocks that rise and collapse to the beat. The camera rapidly pushes through the waveform tunnel with her, while huge vertical text **TRACK 01** scrolls continuously in the background. The waveform suddenly compresses into a single horizontal line and snaps shut behind her on the final beat.

CUT 05 | 4.00–5.10s — She leaps through a giant rotating ring of typography reading **MAX VOLUME**. Camera tracks her mid-air spin in slow motion as the letters scatter, then snap-zoom on her wink.

CUT 06 | 5.10–6.00s — Hard cut: cream editorial card, huge navy **DROP** with an orange slash. She vaults over the word itself, palm planted on the D, legs whipping across frame; the word compresses like a spring under her hand and rebounds.

CUT 07 | 6.00–7.00s — Mint field with a navy diagonal window-bar. She back-flips along the bar in three stroboscopic ghost frames, each ghost tinted mint, orange, or navy. Giant outlined text **LOOP** rotates 180 degrees in sync with her rotation.

CUT 08 | 7.00–8.00s — Kinetic type barrage: the words **LOUD / WILD / TEAL / HEAT** slam in one per beat with shutter flashes and camera shake, while she slides on her knees across the foreground, jacket flaring, music-note particles bursting from her sneakers.

CUT 09 | 8.00–9.00s — Navy frame, giant cream wireframe window-grid tilting in 3D. She runs up the grid like a wall, kicks off, and hangs in the air as everything freezes. An orange circular stamp locks around her pose like a media-player target, with transport icons and EQ ticks.

CUT 10 | 9.00–10.10s — Freeze releases into a burst: she dives toward camera through layered flat-color window panes that shatter one by one like glass shutters, each pane revealing a bigger letter of **P-L-A-Y**. Foreground wipe with her sneaker.

CUT 11 | 10.10–11.10s — Rapid-fire poster montage: four full-screen graphic posters of her in different action poses (mid-flip, sliding, landing, headphones-up wink) snap past with hard cuts. Each has a different bold layout, oversized numbers **01–04**, equalizer strips and slashes.

CUT 12 | 11.10–13.00s — Hero moment on a clean cream cyclorama: she lands a final backflip dead center in slow motion, straightens with one hand on her headphones, and a shockwave of concentric mint rings, wind streaks and shattered typography blasts outward from her landing. Brief iconic freeze on her wink, overexpose to white.

CUT 13 | 13.00–15.00s — Final identity card: enormous navy **PLAY** dominates a pale cream field with translucent mint rings, technical arcs, scanlines, and a rough orange circular emblem containing a ghosted headphone / waveform motif. She stands relaxed overlapping the letters, wind rippling her jacket. One last orange pulse sweeps through the typography and a window-chrome flash punctuates the end.

Editing: extremely aggressive rhythm — hard cuts on every beat, graphic matches, whip pans, snap zooms, stroboscopic freezes, foreground wipes, RGB splits, shutter flashes, impact shakes and speed ramps. Every cut must feel compositionally different. Typography is always fully readable before the character overlaps it. No weapons, no combat, no fire. All energy comes from motion design, wind, glass, UI chrome and her parkour-style athleticism.

BGM: hard-hitting electronic / drum-heavy future bass with aggressive drops, risers, sub hits and glitch fills locked to every cut. Sneaker impacts, whooshes, glass shatters, window-slam hits and typography slams are rhythmic sound-design elements. Peak at CUT 12 and end with a cold electronic logo stinger.

Premium AAA quality, anime-inspired cinematic rendering, stylish and explosive, strong graphic-design identity, consistent character design, exactly 13 cuts.

promptZh:
制作一段由动态图形驱动的角色出场预告：16:9，严格十三个不同镜头，24 帧每秒，总长 15.00 秒。以参考图中的女孩为准，改变图形与字体设计，人物造型保持一致。

角色外观固定，不重新设计：动漫街头服饰女孩，鲜亮薄荷青色高双丸子头，长发尾，带暖橙和金色挑染；凌乱侧分刘海；大号橙色头戴耳机，薄荷色装饰和小标志牌；锐利琥珀橙眼睛，一只眨眼，张嘴俏皮微笑。宽大拼色防风夹克，藏蓝主体、鲜橙袖子、白罗纹袖口、银拉链、圆形青色科技按钮、袖上青色工具口袋；敞开夹克内穿橙色短高领上衣。浅色破洞牛仔短裤、粗橙腰带、银扣。藏蓝过膝袜，橙罗纹袜口，左小腿橙色 X 缝线。厚底白运动鞋带橙色细节。每帧的脸、比例、发型、服装、材质、配饰和颜色完全一致。

影片八成为动态图形设计，两成为角色动作。图形语言是复古操作系统窗口与音乐播放器界面，不是冰霜或条码锁定风格。使用猛然落下的窗口边框、标题栏、关闭和最小化控件、均衡器柱条、波形、进度刻度、文件夹方块、光标箭头、老式显像管扫描线、像素碎裂、唱片圆环印章、音符粒子和播放控制图标。配色为薄荷青、鲜橙、藏蓝、奶油白、银色。结合大型游戏动态图形片头、街头服饰广告和 Windows 时代媒体播放器风格。所有图形快速移动、踩着节拍利落停下。

镜头 01，0.00–1.00 秒：纯图形。薄荷标题栏砸进奶油底，橙色关闭控件撞入角落，两条藏蓝窗口边框擦入。小均衡刻度与进度条闪烁，字母 P、随后 LAY 依次撞入，伴有重击震动。
镜头 02，1.00–2.00 秒：A 变成耳罩。橙色耳罩内出现琥珀眼睛的极近特写，向上看；红绿蓝分色闪光后，耳罩碎成薄荷和橙色平面方块。
镜头 03，2.00–3.10 秒：藏蓝底，巨大奶油色 PLAY。她从左侧冲入，沿文字基线滑行，身后速度线和橙色轨迹，踢起字母碎片如火花。甩镜离开。
镜头 04，3.10–4.00 秒：巨型复古播放器波形在画面爆开，粗薄荷与橙色音频频谱弯成隧道。她高速冲过中心，短暂留下三道频闪动作残影。每道残影留下粗藏蓝均衡器方块，随节拍升起又落下。镜头跟着她快速穿过波形隧道，背景巨大竖排 TRACK 01 持续滚动。最后一拍，波形压缩为水平线，在她身后骤然关闭。
镜头 05，4.00–5.10 秒：她跃过写着 MAX VOLUME 的巨大旋转文字圆环。镜头慢动作跟随空中转体，字母散开，然后突然拉近她的眨眼。
镜头 06，5.10–6.00 秒：硬切到奶油色版式卡，巨大藏蓝 DROP 配橙斜线。她撑着 D 翻越整个词，双腿扫过画面；文字在手下像弹簧压缩后回弹。
镜头 07，6.00–7.00 秒：薄荷底配藏蓝斜窗口栏。她沿栏后空翻，留下三帧分别为薄荷、橙、藏蓝的频闪残影。巨大描边 循环 随她同步旋转 180 度。
镜头 08，7.00–8.00 秒：LOUD / WILD / TEAL / HEAT 每拍撞入一个词，配快门闪光与镜头震动。她在前景跪滑，夹克展开，鞋边爆出音符粒子。
镜头 09，8.00–9.00 秒：藏蓝底，巨大奶油线框窗口网格在三维空间倾斜。她像沿墙一样跑上网格，蹬离后悬在空中，全部冻结。橙色圆章像播放器目标框一样套住她，周围有播放控制图标与均衡器刻度。
镜头 10，9.00–10.10 秒：定格解除并爆开。她向镜头俯冲，穿过多层纯色窗格；每层像玻璃百叶般依次碎裂，逐层露出更大的 P-L-A-Y 字母。运动鞋扫过前景转场。
镜头 11，10.10–11.10 秒：快速海报蒙太奇。四张全屏图形海报硬切闪过，动作分别为空翻中、滑行、落地、抬耳机眨眼。各自使用不同醒目布局、超大 01–04、均衡器条与斜线。
镜头 12，11.10–13.00 秒：干净奶油色无缝背景。她最后一次后空翻，慢动作落在正中，站直后单手扶耳机。落地点向外爆出同心薄荷环、风线与破碎文字。眨眼姿势短暂定格，过曝到白色。
镜头 13，13.00–15.00 秒：结尾身份卡。浅奶油底上巨大藏蓝 PLAY 占据主要画面，搭配半透明薄荷环、技术弧线、扫描线，以及粗糙橙色圆形徽记，内含淡淡耳机和波形。她放松站在文字前，与字母部分重叠，风吹动夹克。最后一道橙色脉冲扫过文字，以窗口边框闪光结束。

剪辑节奏强烈：每拍硬切、图形匹配、甩镜、突然推拉、频闪定格、前景擦过、红绿蓝分色、快门闪光、撞击震动和速度变化。每个镜头构图都明显不同。文字在人物遮挡之前必须完整可读。无武器、战斗、火焰，动感来自图形、风、玻璃、窗口界面和跑酷式运动。

配乐：重击电子乐或鼓点强烈的未来贝斯，包括强烈落差、上升音、低频冲击和故障音填充，与每次切换同步。鞋落地、掠过声、玻璃碎裂、窗口撞击和文字撞击都成为节奏音效。第十二镜达到高峰，最后以冷冽电子标志音结束。

大型动画游戏般的画面质感，动漫电影式渲染，鲜明图形设计，角色始终一致，严格十三镜。

promptOriginal:
一位{argument name="年龄" default="年轻成年"}东亚女性站在{argument name="场景" default="昏暗夜店或镜面电梯厅内"}，画面从头顶拍至大腿中部，人物居中正面面对镜头。身体自然站直，腰部轻微放松，左臂垂在身体侧面，右手抬到右耳附近，手指轻触耳环或整理头发。她直视镜头，神情冷静、自信、略带疏离感，嘴唇自然微启。

深黑色长发自然披散，略带湿润和凌乱感，发丝贴在额头、脸侧、颈部和肩膀，头顶有蓝色灯光轮廓。佩戴大型银色圆环耳环、两条叠戴细银项链、小吊坠、银色腕表和简约戒指。左肩背一只小型金属银色腋下包。
